Hardcore Holly pinned Kane after the Big Show interfered and hit a chokeslam on Kane; after the bout, Kane hit the chokeslam repeatedly on Holly
The Rock defeated Triple H via disqualification when Billy Gunn interfered and hit the Rock with a foreign object
The Godfather fought Edge to a no contest when Droz and Albert came ringside
WWF Tag Team Champion Bradshaw pinned Billy Gunn after X-Pac interfered; after the bout, both Chyna and the Road Dogg came down
WWF IC Champion Jeff Jarrett (w/ Debra) pinned X-Pac after interference from both Debra and Billy Gunn; after the bout, a brawl ensued pitting X-Pac and the Road Dogg against Gunn and Chyna

Steve Austin pinned WWF World Champion the Undertaker (w/ Paul Bearer) to win the title at 12:03 with the Stunner; stipulations stated that if there was any interference from the Corporate Ministry, Taker would be forced for forfeit the title to the challenger

Matt & Jeff Hardy (w/ Michael Hayes) defeated WWF Tag Team Champions the Acolytes to win the titles at 4:25 when Matt pinned Bradshaw with a tornado DDT after Jeff used Michael Hayes' cane as a weapon; Bradshaw wrestled without medical clearance after being tombstoned onto the steel ring steps by Kane on Sunday Night Heat; prior to their entrance, Bradshaw knocked down a medic who tried to stop him from participating in the match; after the match, the new champions and Hayes celebrated at the entrance stage

The Godfather (w/ Val Venis, Albert, & Droz) pinned Gangrel with a legdrop; prior to the bout, the Godfather introduced Albert & Droz as his new hoes; after the bout, Albet & Droz attacked Godfather & Venis, with Gangrel hitting the DDT on the Godfather; moments later, Edge & Christian came out to take Gangrel to the back
Test defeated Joey Abs via disqualification after Pete Gas & Rodney interfered after Test became distracted by Shane & Stephanie McMahon coming to ringside
WWF Hardcore Champion Al Snow pinned D-Lo Brown with a splash through a table after Mideon interfered
The Road Dogg fought Val Venis to a no contest when Road Dogg was arrested for allegedly spray painting Chyna's car; earlier in the night, X-Pac was also arrested
WWF IC Champion Jeff Jarrett (w/ Debra) pinned Chaz (w/ Mariana) after the challenger became distracted by Debra and Mariana fighting at ringside; after the bout, Headbanger Thrasher made the save

Edge pinned the Big Bossman with a spear; after the bout, the Bossman handcuffed Edge to the ring ropes and attacked him with the nightstick; moments later, Christian attempted to make the save but was also beaten down

Billy Gunn (w/ Chyna) pinned Meat (w/ PMS) with the Fameasser after Chyna interfered; after the bout, Chyna attacked Jackie from behind, with she and Gunn spray painting “DX” across the backs of Meat and Jackie

Kane defeated the Big Show & Hardcore Holly in a handicap match by pinning Holly as Show had a staredown with the Undertaker at ringside; after the bout, Kane and Taker attacked Show with Kane eventually leaving ringside as Taker busted Show open with a steel chair

The Rock defeated Triple H (w/ Chyna) in a steel cage match at 13:55 by escaping over the top as Triple H attempted to escape through the door; Triple H escaped the cage first at the 7-minute mark by escaping through the door but the referee had been knocked down, with Rock then dragging Triple H back inside the cage; after the bout, Billy Gunn came ringside as he and Triple H double teamed the Rock
Edge fought Gangrel to a no contest when Gangrel pushed his opponent into the ring of fire on the entrance ramp

The Godfather & Val Venis defeated WWF Tag Team Champions Matt & Jeff Hardy (w/ Michael Hayes) via disqualification when Hayes broke the cover after Venis hit the Money Shot on Jeff; after the bout, the Acolytes attacked the champions, with Val & Godfather helping to make the save
The Rock (sub. for a missing Kane), X-Pac, & the Road Dogg defeated Triple H, Billy Gunn, & Chyna when Rock scored the pin with the People's Elbow
Al Snow pinned Droz in a hardcore evening dress match after accepting Droz' open challenge; after the bout, Albert came ringside and pierced Head with a railroad spike

Test defeated the Mean Street Posse in a gauntlet match; Test pinned Pete Gas at around the 45-second mark; Test pinned Rodney with a pump handle slam; Test defeated Joey Abs via disqualification when Shane McMahon interfered; as Test fought off Shane, Steve Blackman came down and jumped Test before Ken Shamrock quickly followed; moments later, Shane and the Mean Street Posse attempted to break Test's ankle but Shane ended up accidentally hitting Stephanie McMahon – who tried to intervene – knocking her out; Shane and the Posse carried Stephanie backstage
WWF World Champion Steve Austin & the Big Show defeated the Undertaker & Kane when Austin pinned Kane with the Stunner
The Road Dogg fought Chyna to a no contest in a dog collar match when Billy Gunn interfered and helped in hanging Road Dogg over the top rope with the chain until X-Pac made the save

WWF Tag Team Champions Matt & Jeff Hardy (w/ Michael Hayes) defeated Val Venis & the Godfather, the Acolytes, and Albert & Droz in an elimination match; Val pinned Bradshaw with a roll up after Godfather hit Bradshaw with his cane; Jeff scored the pin with a hurricanrana
WWF IC Champion Jeff Jarrett (w/ Debra) pinned Christian with a reverse Russian leg sweep; after the bout, Jarrett sustained a bloodbath before Edge came out and the two brawled
Billy Gunn pinned the Rock with the Fameasser after Chyna interfered and hit Rock with a steel chair

Al Snow fought WWF Hardcore Champion the Big Bossman to a no contest when Snow went crazy, throwing chairs and the timekeeper's bell into the ring, before telling Bossman to hit him; after being hit, Snow was handcuffed to the ropes and beaten with the nightstick
Edge & D-Lo Brown defeated Gangrel & WWF European Champion Mideon when D-Lo pinned Mideon with the Lo Down

Test defeated Steve Blackman via disqualification when the Mean Street Posse interfered; after the bout, Ken Shamrock cleared the ring with a baseball bat before having a stare-down with Blackman on the floor

The Big Show & Hardcore Holly fought X-Pac & Kane to a no contest when the Undertaker came to the ring and attacked every participant but Kane before he and Kane walked up the ramp together; moments later, Kane stopped and returned to the ring to check on X-Pac before the Undertaker showed a replay of him hitting a chokeslam on X-Pac to remind Kane what could happen if he didn't follow him; Kane then hit the chokeslam on Taker before carrying X-Pac backstage

The Undertaker fought Triple H (w/ Chyna & Vince McMahon) to a no contest when the Rock came to the ring and battled with Triple H into the crowd as Steve Austin fought with the Undertaker; moments later, Austin threw Taker into the blood mobile before coming back to the ring and busting Vince open by hitting him in the head with the Smoking Skull belt before signing the contract for the Fully Loaded main event; shortly thereafter, the Undertaker attacked Austin from behind, busting him open as the show came to a close; pre-match stipulations stated that the winner of the match would face Austin at Fully Loaded while the loser would face the Rock

WWF Tag Team Champions the Acolytes defeated Edge & Christian when Edge was pinned following the powerbomb double team, moments after Gangrel led Christian away from ringside; after the bout, guest ring announcer Hardcore Holly announced himself as winner until he was attacked by the champions; moments later, Kane came ringside, attacked the remaining wrestlers, and swore revenge on the Undertaker & Big Show for what they did to X-Pac earlier in the evening
Val Venis & the Godfather defeated Albert & Droz in a streetfight when Venis pinned Albert following a Ho Train / Money Shot combo; during the bout, a fan attacked the Godfather

Kane defeated the Undertaker & the Big Show via disqualification in a handicap match when Undertaker hit Kane with a chair; after the bout, the Road Dogg attempted to make the save but was also beaten down
Triple H defeated Ken Shamrock via referee's decision when Shamrock began bleeding from the mouth, the result of being hit by a car earlier in the evening by Steve Blackman

The Rock fought Billy Gunn and Chyna to a no contest in a handicap match after Steve Austin attacked guest commentar, Triple H, in response to him attacking Jim Ross; the show went off the air moments after the Rock hit the Rock Bottom on Gunn
Edge defeated Gangrel in a Bloodbath match when Christian turned on Gangrel to join his brother; a bucket of blood sat outside the ring and the first to use it would win the match

losers: Jeff Jarrett to unify both titles
matches.line: WWF European Champion D-Lo Brown pinned WWF IC Champion Jeff Jarrett (w/ Debra) to unify both titles after hitting him with one of the title belts, brought in the ring by Debra
The Undertaker & the Big Show defeated the Road Dogg & Kane when Taker pinned Kane with the tombstone; Hardcore Holly jumped the Acolytes after the match with a baseball bat
WWF Hardcore Champion the Big Bossman pinned Viscera
Test defeated Rodney
Steve Blackman fought Val Venis to a no contest when Ken Shamrock chased Blackman all over the building

WWF World Champion Steve Austin fought the Undertaker to a no contest in a No Holds Barred match when the Big Show, Triple H, the Acolytes, Kane, the Road Dogg, Hardcore Holly, Billy Gunn, and the Rock interfered; after the match, Austin hit the Stunner on Triple H and the Big Show

Gangrel pinned Christian after spitting blood in his face, moments after Christian attacked the Hardy Boyz on the floor; after the bout, Edge attempted to make the save but was triple teamed by Gangrel and the Hardyz; Michael Hayes then attempted to make the save but the same result occured
Val Venis pinned Jeff Jarrett (w/ Debra) with a roll up after Jarrett became distracted by Debra on the apron; after the match, Debra left ringside with Venis

Kane & X-Pac defeated WWF Tag Team Champions the Acolytes to win the titles at 4:36 when X-Pac pinned Farooq by reversing the Dominator into the X-Factor; after the bout, the Road Dogg came ringside to celebrate; moments later, X-Pac took the mic and prompted Kane to speak, but without his voice box; Kane then said “Suck it!” (Kane & X-Pac's first appearance with their mixed entrance music)

Test & Ken Shamrock defeated Steve Blackman & Joey Abs when Test pinned Abs; after the bout, Test locked Abs' ankle in a steel chair and jumped on it before chasing Shane McMahon, who did guest commentary for the match, backstage
The Road dogg pinned WWF Hardcore Champion the Big Bossman in a non-title match after Al Snow interfered and hit the champion with Pepper's dog cage
The Rock defeated the Big Show via disqualification when Chris Jericho interfered to break the cover after the People's Elbow; after the bout, Billy Gunn attacked the Rock

Chyna defeated Triple H and the Undertaker in a No DQ falls count anywhere match by pinning Triple H after Steve Austin interfered, hit Triple H with a chair on the floor, and laid Chyna across him; Shawn Michaels was the guest referee for the bout while Jesse Ventura did guest commentary; due to prematch stipulations, Chyna became the #1 contender for the world title at Summer Slam, taking the spot away from Triple H
The Road Dogg pinned Al Snow after the Big Bossman interfered, hit both men with the nightstick, and Road Dogg fell on top for the win

Chyna pinned Triple H after Mankind interfered and hit Triple H with the steel ring steps; due to prematch stipulations, Chyna earned a world title shot for Summer Slam; after the bout, Mankind challenged Chyna to a match for the main event spot; she turned him down by hitting a low blow but Shawn Michaels made the match official for later in the night

Test defeated Steve Blackman via disqualification after Blackman hit Test with his kendo stick; after the bout, Ken Shamrock attempted to make the save but was beaten down; Test then hit a spear on an interfering Shane McMahon but eventually had the kendo stick broken over his back proir to Shane and Blackman leaving ringside together
WWF Tag Team Champions X-Pac & Kane defeated the Acolytes when Kane pinned Bradshaw with a chokeslam; after the bout, the challengers continued to attack Kane & X-Pac

Mankind pinned Chyna with the Mandible Claw; due to prematch stipulations, Mankind won Chyna's world title shot for Summer Slam; after the bout, Triple H and Chyna double teamed Mankind until Shane McMahon made a match between Mankind and Triple H for later in the night to determine the #1 contender; stipulations added included the match to be No Holds Barred and falls count anywhere, with Shane and Shawn Michaels as the two special referees

Mankind fought Triple H to a no contest when both men were pinned, as Shawn Michaels counted Triple H down while Shane McMahon counted Mankind down, following a Triple H suplex onto a steel chair; the ring announcer claimed both men were victorious and thus the world title match at Summer Slam would be a triple threat match; after the bout, Steve Austin – who did guest commentary – attacked Shane McMahon while Mankind and Triple H continued brawling in the ring

WWF Hardcore Champion Al Snow fought the Road Dogg to a no contest at around the 2-minute mark when Chris Jericho came ringside and began brawling with Road Dogg, seconds after Snow was powerbombed through a table on the floor, with Jericho and Road Dogg then fighting their way backstage; moments later, the Big Bossman came out, assaulted Snow with the nightstick, and stole Pepper the dog; as cameras caught Jericho and Road Dogg fighting backstage, Bossman was shown throwing the dog cage into his car and leaving the arena

The Acolytes fought WWF Tag Team Champions the Undertaker & the Big Show to a no contest at 1:38 when X-Pac & Kane, who did guest commentary for the bout, became involved in a ringside brawl against the four participants; after the bout, Taker hit Kane with a steel chair to the head while on the floor while Show hit the chokeslam on X-Pac inside the ring; the bout featured the debut of Lilian Garcia as ring announcer

D-Lo Brown (sub. for Meat) defeated WWF European Champion Mark Henry (w/ WWF IC Champion Jeff Jarrett, Debra, & Miss Kitty) via disqualification at the 58-second mark when Jarrett broke the cover after D-Lo hit the frog splash; prior to the bout, Jarrett rewarded Mark Henry for his help the previous night by giving him the European Championship and he rewarded Debra by presenting her with her own personal assistant, Miss Kitty; Jarrett then stated that he had an open challenge to face anyone for the IC title and a contract was taped to his dressing room door for anyone to sign; as Meat prepared to make his way out to the ring, D-Lo attacked Stasiak backstage and took his place in the match (Miss Kitty's debut)

The Rock pinned Gangrel (w/ Matt & Jeff Hardy) at 4:33 with the Rock Bottom / People's Elbow combo; moments earlier, Edge & Christian came out to chase the interfering Hardy Boyz backstage; after the bout, the Rock cut a promo in the ring, saying that he should be the #1 contender to the world title and would take matters into his own hands
Crash Holly fought Hardcore Holly to a no contest at around the 3-minute mark when the battle went outside the arena

Mideon & Viscera defeated X-Pac & Kane at 4:17 when Viscera pinned X-Pac with a splash in the corner followed by a regular splash as the Acolytes, who came ringside mid-way through the bout, attacked Kane on the floor; Paul Bearer, WWF Tag Team Champions the Undertaker & the Big Show did guest commentary for the bout and Michael Cole went without his headset for the match

Triple H (w/ Chyna) pinned WWF World Champion Mankind to win the title at 8:43 with the Pedigree; moments prior to the finish, Triple H hit the champion with a chair shot to the head on the floor, then did the same to the Rock, who was doing guest commentary for the bout; seconds later, Shane McMahon – who was the original referee for the bout until being knocked to the floor and having Earl Hebner replace him – pulled Hebner to the floor and knocked him out before sliding in the ring and making the 3-count; Chyna came ringside early in the bout, still selling the guitar shot from Jeff Jarrett earlier in the show

Pete Gas, Joey Abs, & Rodney defeated Mankind via disqualification in a handicap match at 4:25 when, after laying out all three opponents and having Shane ignore the cover, Mankind applied the Mandible Claw on Shane; moments later, Mankind fought off an interfering Triple H and sent him to the floor; prior to the bout, Shane McMahon sent referee Teddy Long to the back as he himself would be the guest referee for the bout; after the match, Lilian Garcia mistakenly announced Mankind as the winner via DQ until Shane returned ringside and corrected her; pre-match stipulations stated that if Mankind was victorious, Mankind would earn a world title shot later in the show

WWF Tag Team Champion the Big Show (w/ Paul Bearer & WWF Tag Team Champion the Undertaker) (sub. for the Undertaker) pinned the Rock in a falls count anywhere match at 3:38 with one foot on his chest following a chokeslam through the commentary table; prior to the bout, Taker cut a promo in the ring saying that Rock had not earned the right to face him so Rock would wrestle the Big Show instead; Taker then did guest color commentary for the match; after the bout, Triple H came out and assaulted the Rock while he was still down on the floor but was eventually caught in a choke by Taker; moments later, Mankind came out to make the save for Rock but was also beaten down by Taker & Show; pre-match stipulations stated that if Rock was victorious, Rock would earn a world title shot later in the show

X-Pac pinned Taka Michinoku (w/ Sho Funaki) at 3:06 with a kick to the midsection and the X-Factor after avoiding the Michinoku Driver; moments later, X-Pac hit the move on Funaki; after the bout, Michael Cole conducted an interview with X-Pac at ringside in which he said he wanted the “big guys”, implying Taker & Kane

The Acolytes Matt & Jeff Hardy, Crash & Hardcore Holly, and Edge & Christian fought to a no contest at 1:04 in an elimination match when Viscera & Mideon, Albert & Droz, and Stevie Richards & the Blue Meanie interfered, with all 14 men brawling in and outside the ring; after the bout, a number of officials attempted to break the fights up; pre-match stipulations stated that the winners of the bout would be named #1 contenders to the tag team titles

WWF IC Champion Jeff Jarrett (w/ Debra & Miss Kitty) & WWF European Champion Mark Henry defeated D-Lo Brown & Billy Gunn at 3:37 when Jarrett pinned Gunn after Chyna, who did guest commentary for the bout, interfered and accidentally broke Jarrett's guitar over Gunn's head as she tried to hit Jarrett; during the bout, it was announced that Chyna would face Jarrett for the IC title at Unforgiven

Ken Shamrock defeated Gangrel at 5:25 with a sunset flip into the ankle lock; Matt & Jeff Hardy were in Gangrel's corner for the bout but were sent backstage a minute into the bout after interfering; after the bout, Howard Finkel came out and introduced Chris Jericho, with Jericho's Titan Tron playing before Jericho appeared on the big screen and told Shamrock to show up to Smackdown!; moments later, Shamrock ran backstage to find Jericho

Mankind & the Rock defeated WWF Tag Team Champions the Big Show & the Undertaker to win the titles at 8:13 when Rock pinned Show after hitting him over the head with a steel chair followed by a double People's Elbow from both challengers; Taker never legally tagged in and actually walked out of the match at around the 6-minute mark after Paul Bearer came ringside and showed him something in his jacket

WWF Tag Team Champions the Rock & Mankind defeated WWF World Champion Triple H (w/ Chyna) (sub. for X-Pac) & Kane at 4:27 when Rock pinned Kane with the Rock Bottom and People's Elbow after Triple H hit his partner with the sledgehammer behind the referee's back; following Rock's entrance, he cut a promo on Kane's voice box, saying he would shove it up Kane's ass; after Mankind's entrance, he took the mic, gave well wishes from his friends in the WWF to “Brian” (Brian Hildebrand) and said he was happy to be in “Harvard;” X-Pac failed to appear for the contest, with Kane then prompting to go ahead and have it as a handicap match; moments later, Triple H came out and stood in Kane's corner, with Chyna standing at ringside with a sledgehammer; after the match, Triple H entered the ring and assaulted Kane with the weapon but fled ringside after the Undertaker and Big Show came to the ring
WWF IC Champion Jeff Jarrett (w/ Miss Kitty) defeated Jackie via submission with the figure-4; after the match, he hit her over the head with a guitar
Edge & Christian defeated the Acolytes when Edge pinned Bradshaw after a missile dropkick; due to prematch stipulations, Edge & Christian became the #1 contenders to the tag team titles
The Big Show pinned Val Venis by catching Val coming off the top and hitting the chokeslam; after the match, Steve Blackman attacked Val with his kendo stick
Test, Gerald Brisco, & Pat Patterson defeated the Mean Street Posse (w/ Terri) when Test pinned Rodney after Stan Stasiak interfered
Hardcore & Crash Holly defeated Matt & Jeff Hardy when Hardcore pinned Matt; after the match, Hardcore and Crash brawled
D-Lo Brown pinned Steve Blackman with the Lo Down after Val Venis stole Blackman's duffel bag; after the match, Mark Henry, who had been doing commentary, attacked D-Lo
WWF Women's Champion Ivory pinned Tori in a hardcore match after smashing a mirror over her head (the match did not air on TSN in Canada due to Tori's wet underwear and shirt outfit)
WWF World Champion Triple H pinned Billy Gunn with the Pedigree; after the match, Kane took out the champion, Chyna, and Shane McMahon as the show came to a close

Luna defeated WWF IC Champion Jeff Jarrett via disqualification when Ivory interfered and hit Luna with Jarrett's guitar; after the match, Jarrett put Lillian Garcia in the figure-4 for announcing Luna as the winner
D-Von Dudley defeated Farooq in a strap match after Bubba Ray Dudley interfered and hit Farooq with a chair; after the match, Bradshaw cleared the ring of the Dudleyz
Test pinned Joey Abs (w/ the Mean Street Posse) with a powerbomb; after the match, Shane McMahon and Test fought off the Mean Street Posse and chased them out of the arena
WWF World Champion Triple H fought Steve Austin to a no contest when Austin was handcuffed and led away by police before the bout began
The Godfather pinned Chaz with the Ho Train and the Pimp Drop
Chris Jericho defeated Gotch Gracie (Mr. Hughes under a mask) via submission with the Walls of Jericho in a steel cage match; after the match, both men attacked Ken Shamrock (Hughes' return match)

The Undertaker, Mankind, the Big Show, Kane, and the Rock fought to a no contest when Mideon & Viscera attacked Mankind and a number of referees were knocked out by participants before other wrestlers broke the fight up
D-Lo Brown & Val Venis defeated Steve Blackman & WWF European Champion Mark Henry when D-Lo pinned Blackman with the Lo-Down after a fisherman suplex from Venis
WWF World Champion Triple H defeated Steve Austin via disqualification when the challenger used a chair and assaulted the referee
Chris Jericho defeated Billy Gunn via submission with the Walls of Jericho

The Dudley Boyz defeated Matt & Jeff Hardy when Bubba Ray pinned Matt; after the bout, the Acolytes – who were doing guest commentary for the bout – attacked the Dudleyz and Stevie Richards (who was dressed as a Dudley Boy)

Test & Stephanie McMahon defeated WWF IC Champion Jeff Jarrett & Debra when Stephanie pinned Jarrett after a flying elbowsmash from Test; during the bout, Debra refused to be tagged in and after the match Jarrett put her in the figure-4

sub_for: WWF Tag Team Champion the Undertaker
matches.line: The Rock & Mankind defeated Mideon, Viscera (sub. for WWF Tag Team Champion the Undertaker), & WWF Tag Team Champion the Big Show in a handicap match following the People's Elbow to win the titles; prior to the contest, the Undertaker made the match under ‘darkside rules' and took himself out of the bout before attacking his own tag team partner
Shawn Stasiak pinned Steve Blackman with a roll up after Blackman went to his bag of weapons and pulled out a vibrator, which had been placed inside by guest commentator Val Venis
Hardcore Holly (w/ Crash Holly) pinned the Big Bossman in a hardcore match after Crash interfered

Shane McMahon & Test (sub. for Vince McMahon) defeated Triple H & Chyna via disqualification when Triple H hit both opponents with a steel chair; after the bout, Vince – who had been locked in his dressing room backstage – came to ringside and hit Triple H with a chair

The Big Show defeated Chris Jericho (w/ Curtis Hughes) via disqualification when Albert, who was doing guest commentary for the bout, attacked Show; after the bout, the Road Dogg attacked Hughes as Jericho escaped from ringside

WWF European Champion D-Lo Brown defeated Steve Blackman via disqualification when Blackman hit the champion with a kendo stick; after the bout, guest commentator Droz attacked D-Lo and threw up on him; Mark Henry made the save but D-Lo didn't want his help
WWF Tag Team Champions Billy Gunn & the Road Dogg defeated X-Pac & Kane via disqualification when Hardcore & Crash Holly attacked the champions; Kane & X-Pac helped in fighting them off
The Fabulous Moolah & Mae Young defeated WWF Women's Champion Ivory in a handicap evening gown match

Chyna & Debra defeated Tom Pritchard & WWF IC Champion Jeff Jarrett (w/ Miss Kitty) when Chyna pinned Jarrett after Pritchard hit her with a guitar and she fell on top of Jarrett; due to prematch stipulations, Chyna earned an IC title rematch for No Mercy
The Rock fought WWF World Champion Triple H to a no contest when Davey Boy Smith attacked both men as the Rock had Triple H pinned; Steve Austin was the guest commentator for the bout

The Acolytes defeated WWF Tag Team Champions Billy Gunn & the Road Dogg, Kane & X-Pac, and Hardcore & Crash Holly when Bradshaw pinned X-Pac; Kane pinned Farooq at the same time but they were the illegal men in the match

TIT Invitational Best of 7 Series : Edge & Christian defeated Matt & Jeff Hardy at 4:20 when Edge pinned Jeff with a spear, jumping off Christian's back, as Jeff came off the top rope; Edge & Christian: 2, Hardys: 0; Terri Runnels provided guest commentary for the bout

sub_for: WWF IC Champion Jeff Jarrett who decided to do commentary instead
matches.line: The Fabulous Moolah & Mae Young defeated Miss Kitty (sub. for WWF IC Champion Jeff Jarrett who decided to do commentary instead) & Ivory when Kitty was pinned; after the match, Jarrett put Kitty in the figure-4 for losing

Chyna defeated Davey Boy Smith via disqualification when Jeff Jarrett interfered and hit Chyna with a coffee can; after the match, Smith called Triple H out and gave him a count of 10 before hitting the powerslam on Chyna – but instead only gave a count of 3 before executing the move
The Dudley Boyz defeated Mankind & Stevie Richards (dressed as Dude Love) following the 3D on Richards as Mankind had the Mandible Claw applied on Val Venis, who was doing commentary
The Rock pinned Chris Jericho (w/ Curtis Hughes) with a Rock Bottom onto a chair followed by the People's Elbow; after the match, Davey Boy Smith came ringside and began brawling with the Rock
Billy Gunn (w/ the Road Dogg) pinned Crash Holly (w/ Hardcore Holly) with the Fameasser after 48 seconds; after the match, Hardcore knocked out both Outlaws with Crash's scale
WWF Women's Champion Ivory defeated Mae Young via disqualification in a non-title match when the Fabulous Moolah interfered
Edge & Christian fought Matt & Jeff Hardy to a double count-out at 4:45when all four men began brawling on the floor; this was the 3rd match in the TIT Invitational

X-Pac pinned Farooq (w/ Bradshaw) at 3:21 by reversing the Dominator into the X-Factor; after the match, Kane made the save against the Acolytes which upset X-Pac since he said he didn't want any help
The Headbangers defeated Chris Jericho & Curtis Hughes at 3:27 when Hughes was pinned after Jericho walked out of the match
The Godfather pinned Mark Henry in a Ho Jack match (lumberjack with hoes surrounding the ring) at 1:24 with the Ho Train and a roll up

The Big Show defeated the Big Bossman via disqualification at the 37 second mark when Bossman used his nightstick as a weapon; after the match, Al Snow attempted to make the save but was also beaten down

Steve Austin & Jim Ross fought WWF World Champion Triple H & Chyna to a no contest at around the 5-minute mark when, after Austin and Triple H fought their way backstage, WWF IC Champion Jeff Jarrett came out and knocked out Chyna by hitting her in the head with a toaster; moments later, Miss Kitty wheeled a laundry bin ringside, where Jarrett dumped Chyna inside and wheeled her backstage; moments later, Austin and Triple H brawled their way into the crowd where Austin threw Triple H into a beer stand and then celebrated with a beer; a backstage camera then showed Jarrett wheeling the laundry bin with Chyna inside off a ledge in another area of the building (Ross's debut match)
The Rock & Mankind fought Val Venis & Davey Boy Smith to a no contest when Mankind chased Venis backstage and the Rock hit the Rock Bottom on Smith onto dog crap

X-Pac & Kane defeated the Dudley Boyz when Kane pinned Bubba Ray with a chokeslam following an enzuiguri from X-Pac at 3:45; early in the contest, the Headbangers came ringside to distract the Dudleyz; after the match, the Headbangers brawled with the Dudleyz on the floor until they were held apart by referees
Viscera (w/ Mideon) pinned the Godfather at 2:09 with a blow from behind and a splash after Godfather knocked Mideon off the ring apron

Test defeated Davey Boy Smith via disqualification at 2:17 when the Mean Street Posse interfered as Test prepared to hit Smith with a trash can; after the bout, Smith assaulted Test with the trash can and officially joined forces with the Mean Street Posse before eventually hitting the running powerslam
Val Venis pinned Al Snow with the Money Shot at 4:39 after shoving Snow off the top

WWF Hardcore Champion the Big Bossman defeated the Big Show via forfeit after Show was told backstage by a police officer that his father had passed away; later in the show it was revealed, via G-TV, that the Bossman paid the man to lie to Show and tell him about his father's death

Billy Gunn & the Road Dogg defeated the Acolytes (w/ Howard Finkel) at 4:58 when Road Dogg pinned Bradshaw by reversing a piledriver attempt into a roll over after Gunn hit Bradshaw in the back with a steel chair, placed in the ring by Finkel; mid-way through the bout, the top rope fell off one of the corners and, after being assaulted with the turnbuckle pad, Gunn was busted open; after the bout, Bradshaw gave Finkel a wedgie as the Acolytes forced him backstage

Hardcore & Crash Holly defeated WWF Tag Team Champions the Rock & Mankind to win the titles at 7:30 when Hardcore pinned Rock after Triple H interfered behind the referee's back and hit the Pedigree; Mick Foley sat on the ring steps with his back to the ring for the duration of the match and left immediately after the decision; after the bout, Steve Austin attacked Triple H from behind on the stage, throwing him in the ring where Rock followed by hitting the Rock Bottom; as Rock attempted the People's Elbow, Austin gave him two middle fingers and then hit the Stunner on Triple H instead

Viscera pinned the Godfather (w/ Mark Henry) after Henry nailed the Godfather from behind; due to prematch stipulations, Viscera won the Godfather's hoes and allowed Henry to have them any time he wanted

Edge & Christian defeated WWF Tag Team Champions Hardcore & Crash Holly via disqualification when Grandmaster Sexay & Scotty 2 Hotty prevented the pinfall after Edge hit the spear on Crash; after the bout, the Hardy Boyz made the save (Grandmaster Sexay & Scotty 2 Hotty's return)
Ivory pinned WWF Women's Champion the Fabulous Moolah (w/ Mae Young) to win the title in an impromptu match

The Big Show fought Prince Albert to a no contest when the Big Bossman came ringside and told the Big Show that he pulled the plug on Show's father at the hospital and stole his watch; Bossman and Albert attacked Show to end the segment

WWF IC Champion Chyna (w/ Miss Kitty) & WWF European Champion D-Lo Brown defeated Chris Jericho & Stevie Richards (dressed in disguise as a female fan) when Chyna pinned Richards; after the match, Jericho put Richards in the Walls of Jericho

Mankind defeated WWF World Champion Triple H via disqualification when Val Venis interfered as Mankind had the Mandible Claw applied and hit the challenger with a chair; after the match, Al Snow made the save
Kane defeated Bubba Ray Dudley (w/ D-Von Dudley) via disqualification when D-Von interfered; after the match, X-Pac made the save

Test fought Davey Boy Smith to a no contest in a steel cage match at around the 4-minute mark; late in the match, the Mean Street Posse came through the crowd and broke into the cage after Test hit an elbowdrop off the top of the cage; in the melee, the Smith escaped through the door, although the bell never rung nor was any decision announced; Shane McMahon made the save for Test by leaping off the top of the cage onto the Posse; after Test came to Shane's aid moments later, Stephanie McMahon came to the ring to tend to and celebrate with her brother and fiancee

WWF Tag Team Champions Billy Gunn & the Road Dogg defeated Steve Austin & the Rock when Gunn pinned Rock after X-Pac interfered and hit a spinning heel kick on Rock; after the bout, X-Pac and Triple H helped with the tag champions in attacking the challengers, thus reforming DX
The Rock fought the Road Dogg to a no contest when DX and Vince McMahon interfered
Matt & Jeff Hardy & Edge & Christian defeated Grandmaster Sexay & Scotty 2 Hotty & Crash & Hardcore Holly after Edge hit the spear
Mankind & Al Snow defeated the Big Bossman & Albert when Snow pinned Albert after throwing him into a table
WWF IC Champion Chyna pinned Stevie Richards with a low blow and the Pedigree; after the match, Chris Jericho attacked the champion from behind and applies the Walls of Jericho
Steve Austin pinned Billy Gunn with the Stunner; after the bout, Austin held off DX with a chair
Test defeated Val Venis via count-out when Mankind chased Val from ringside; after the bout, Stephanie McMahon proposed to Test, with him accepting
Kane fought X-Pac to a no contest when DX interfered and attacked Kane
The Headbangers defeated the Dudley Boyz after Thrasher hit a DDT; after the match, the Mean Street Posse attacked the Headbangers

WWF World Champion Triple H pinned Shane McMahon after Vince McMahon interfered and inadvertantly hit Shane with the title belt; the Rock was the special time keeper for the bout, Steve Austin was the guest commentator, and Kane was the guest enforcer; all three men paired off with members of DX during the bout and battled away from ringside
The Road Dogg & Billy Gunn defeated WWF Tag Team Champions Mankind & Al Snow to win the titles when Dogg pinned Snow after a chair shot from Gunn
The Godfather defeated Val Venis via count-out when Val and Mankind fought into the crowd
Edge & Christian & the Headbangers defeated Davey Boy Smith & the Mean Street Posse when Christian pinned Pete Gas

The Rock pinned X-Pac by blocking the X-Factor and hitting the Rock Bottom; after the bout, DX attacked the Rock until Vince McMahon came out and ordered Triple H to defend the title against Test in the main event; seconds later, the Rock laid out the champion with the Rock Bottom and People's Elbow
The Big Bossman pinned Kane after hitting him with the nightstick after Albert interfered
Crash & Hardcore Holly defeated Grandmaster Sexay & Scotty 2 Hotty when Hardcore scored the pin with a suplex

WWF World Champion Triple H defeated Test via count-out when Test, Vince & Shane McMahon ran backstage after Stephanie McMahon had been kidnapped by DX; Vince McMahon was the guest time keeper and Shane McMahon the guest referee for the bout
Mankind defeated Val Venis via submission with the Mandible Claw at 4:51
Kurt Angle pinned the Godfather with the Olympic Slam at 2:58 after the Godfather became distracted by a fan at ringside that had a sign reading ‘World Wide Filth'
Gangrel (w/ Luna) pinned Chris Jericho with a northern lights suplex at 1:27 after Jericho became distracted by Chyna and Miss Kitty at ringside
WWF World Champion the Big Show defeated WWF European Champion Davey Boy Smith (w/ the Mean Street Posse) via disqualification at the 33-second mark after the Posse interfered
WWF Tag Team Champion the Road Dogg pinned Al Snow at 4:14 with the pumphandle slam; after the bout, Mankind cheered Snow up following the loss
Test pinned WWF Tag Team Champion Billy Gunn with a roll up at 4:30 after avoiding the Fameasser; after the bout, Gunn hit the Fameasser on Test
Triple H defeated Kane via disqualification at 4:42 when Vince McMahon interfered; after the bout, Kane hit a chokeslam on Triple H

WWF Hardcore Champion the Big Bossman pinned the Rock in a non-title hardcore match with the sidewalk slam at 4:41 after Albert distracted the Rock; following the bout, the Rock attacked both men as well as several officials; due to prematch stipulations, the Bossman became the #1 contender to the WWF World Title
Crash & Hardcore Holly defeated Mankind & Al Snow when Crash pinned Snow following a dropkick from Hardcore as Snow attempted the Snow Plow on Crash
Kurt Angle pinned Mark Henry with the Angle Slam
Chris Jericho pinned the Godfather with the Lionsault
Edge & Christian defeated the Dudley Boyz when D-Von was pinned
X-Pac (w/ WWF Tag Team Champions the Road Dogg & Billy Gunn) pinned Jeff Hardy (w/ Matt Hardy & Terri Runnels) with the X-Factor after Gunn and Road Dogg interfered

WWF World Champion the Big Show defeated Kane (mystery opponent) via count-out when the challenger attacked Viscera on the floor, who had chased Tori to ringside; after the bout, Show hit a powerslam on Viscera

Grandmaster Sexay & Scotty 2 Hotty defeated Val Venis & WWF European Champion Davey Boy Smith via disqualification when the Mean Street Posse attacked Grandmaster Sexay & Scotty 2 Hotty after Venis walked out of the match; after the bout, Rikishi made the save and danced with Grandmaster Sexay & Scotty 2 Hotty
Test pinned WWF Tag Team Champion the Road Dogg after interference from guest referee Shane McMahon

The Rock & Mankind defeated WWF Hardcore Champion the Big Bossman & Albert when Mankind made the pin after the Rock Bottom / People's Elbow combo from the Rock; the bout was originally a 2-on-1 handicap match but Mankind came to the Rock's aid mid-way through the contest

Triple H fought the Acolytes to a no contest in a no holds barred handicap match after Vince McMahon prevented Triple H from leaving ringside, hit him with a chair, and threw him off the stage; prematch stipulations stated that if any member of DX interfered in the match they would be suspended for 30 days

Viscera & WWF Hardcore Champion the Big Bossman defeated Kane (w/ Tori) & WWF World Champion the Big Show when Viscera pinned Kane after X-Pac interfered and hit the X-Factor on Kane; after the bout, X-Pac hit Tori with a spin kick
Edge (w/ Christian) pinned Matt Hardy (w/ Jeff Hardy & Terri Runnels) with the spear as all four men were fighting in the ring
Steve Blackman pinned the Godfather
Grandmaster Sexay & Scotty 2 Hotty (w/ Rikishi) defeated Hardcore & Crash Holly when Crash was pinned; after the bout, Rikishi fought off Hardcore
Test pinned Triple H with the flying elbowsmash after Shane McMahon interfered as Triple H attempted to pull the Vince McMahon mask off the referee
Kurt Angle pinned Val Venis after Davey Boy Smith interfered and hit Venis with a chair

X-Pac & WWF Tag Team Champions the Road Dogg & Billy Gunn defeated the Rock, Kane, & Mankind via disqualification when Al Snow interfered and hit the DX members with Head after Rock hit the Rock Bottom on Gunn; after the bout, Rock hit the People's Elbow on Snow for costing him the match
Grandmaster Sexay & Scotty 2 Hotty defeated WWF Tag Team Champions Billy Gunn & the Road Dogg via disqualification when Crash & Hardcore Holly interfered; Rikishi made the save
Kurt Angle & Steve Blackman defeated Matt & Jeff Hardy (w/ Terri) after Blackman hit Jeff with his kendo stick, with Angle getting the pin

Val Venis fought D-Lo Brown to a no contest when Davey Boy Smith and the Mean Street Posse attacked both men; prematch stipulations called for the winner to be named the #1 contender to Smith's European title
The Godfather pinned Prince Albert with the Ho Train
Rikishi pinned Hardcore Holly with a splash off the middle turnbuckle
Triple H & X-Pac defeated Test & Kane (w/ Tori) when Triple H pinned Test following a low blow and the Pedigree
WWF World Champion the Big Show pinned Viscera with a missile dropkick off the top
The Rock & Mankind defeated Al Snow & Chris Jericho via disqualification when Billy Gunn & the Road Dogg interfered
WWF IC Champion Chris Jericho defeated X-Pac
Mark Henry pinned the Godfather with a roll up after Mae Young distracted the Godfather from ringside
The Rock & Mankind defeated the Dudley Boyz when Rock made the pin; Rock & Mankind originally won the match via disqualification but Triple H overruled the decision and made the bout a No DQ match

WWF Women's Champion the Kat pinned Tori in a chocolate pudding match after outside interference from X-Pac backfired; after the match, the New Age Outlaws attacked Kane – who threw X-Pac into the pudding; prior to the match, the champion renamed herself the Kat and threw ring announcer Lilian Garcia into the pudding after the contest for forgetting to call her as such
The Acolytes fought the Mean Street Posse to a no contest in a handicap match after destroying their opponents and walking out of the match
Edge & Christian defeated Matt & Jeff Hardy in a steel cage match when Edge escaped through the door after Matt Hardy and Christian had previously escaped over the top
WWF Tag Team Champions the Road Dogg & Billy Gunn pinned Kane in a triple threat match after Gunn hit the Fameasser

WWF World Champion the Big Show defeated WWF Hardcore Champion the Big Bossman & Albert in a handicap match by pinning the Bossman after hitting chokeslams on both men; prematch stipulations stated that had Bossman's team won he would have become the new world champion
WWF Tag Team Champions the Road Dogg & Billy Gunn fought Triple H & Test to a no contest when Triple H attacked his partner; after the match, DX ganged up on Test and Stephanie McMahon slapped him
Jeff Hardy & Christian defeated Matt Hardy & Edge
Kurt Angle pinned Viscera after Steve Blackman interfered and hit Viscera with his kendo stick
The Dudley Boyz, the Acolytes, and Mae Young & the Fabulous Moolah fought to a no contest when Mark Henry came to the aid of Young and Moolah and helped the Acolytes against the Dudleyz
Mankind fought the Mean Street Posse (dressed as Santa Claus) to a no contest in a Boiler Room Brawl when the New Age Outlaws and Triple H interfered
WWF IC Champion Chris Jerihco pinned the Godfather after Chyna interfered and gave the Godfather a low blow
Hardcore Holly (w/ Terri Runnels) defeated Val Venis (w/ BB) in a bout where whenever a participant was thrown to the floor his valet would have to take off an article of clothing
Al Snow defeated the Rock in a Brahma Bull bullrope match after the New Age Outlaws interfered
Grandmaster Sexay & Scotty 2 Hotty & Rikishi defeated the Mean Street Posse

WWF World Champion the Big Show defeated Kane (w/ Tori) in a No DQ falls count anywhere match at 6:55 after dropping him with a powerbomb through the commentary table; stipulations stated Tori would have to spend the holidays with X-Pac if Show won; prior to the match, Triple H & Stephanie McMahon took a seat at the entrance stage to watch the bout; at the 2:14 mark, referee Mike Chioda stopped the match and awarded it to Kane via disqualification after Show hit Kane with a steel chair on the floor; moments later, Triple H took the mic and informed Chioda the match was No DQ; at the 3:05 mark, the two were counted-out, with Stephanie saying it was a No count-out match and Triple H adding the falls count anywhere stipulation; at the 6-minute mark, WWF Tag Team Champions Billy Gunn & the Road Dogg came out, distracting Kane and Tori from ringside; after the bout, Gunn & Road Dogg carried Tori up the ramp
Chyna (w/ the Kat) pinned Crash Holly at 1:11; Hardcore Holly did guest commentary for the bout

The Dudley Boyz defeated the Acolytes at 2:40 after the Mean Street Posse interfered and guest referee Joey Abs gave a fast count; prior to the bout, Rodney and Pete Gas were introduced as the special time keeper and ring announcer (the Dudleyz' first appearance in the blue camouflage)

Kurt Angle defeated the Headbangers in a handicap match at the 50-second mark after Steve Blackman interfered and hit Mosh with a kendo stick; after the bout, the Headbangers hit a guillotine legdrop on Angle before Blackman cleared them from the ring
Al Snow defeated WWF IC Champion Chris Jericho via disqualification at 1:30 when Chyna interfered and hit Snow with Head

The Rock defeated Mankind in a Pink Slip on a Pole match at 9:30 after hitting the Rock Bottom on a distracted Mankind, moments after Al Snow appeared ringside; due to pre-match stipulations, Mankind was fired from the company; after the bout, Mankind cut a goodbye promo, saying he planned to retire in 2000 but not this early
Albert & Ivory defeated Val Venis & WWF Women's Champion the Kat, Gangrel & Luna, and Viscera & Jackie at 2:17 when Albert pinned Venis
X-Pac pinned Jeff Hardy (w/ Matt Hardy & Terri) with the X-Factor at 4:08
Test defeated Kane (w/ Tori) via disqualification at 2:57 when Kane shoved the referee; after the bout, Kane hit the tombstone on Test

WWF Tag Team Champions the Road Dogg & Billy Gunn defeated Grandmaster Sexay & Scotty 2 Hotty at 2:22 after interference from both Rikishi and X-Pac, with X-Pac attacking Grandmaster Sexay and leading to the pin; after the bout, Rikishi helped in clearing the ring and then danced with Grandmaster Sexay & Scotty 2 Hotty

WWF World Champion the Big Show pinned Triple H (w/ DX) with the chokeslam in a No DQ match at 5:58 after Mankind interfered and hit Triple H in the back of the head with a chair; prior to the bout, the challenger announced it would be No DQ and the remaining members of DX interfered throughout the bout

The Dudley Boyz defeated Too Cool (w/ Rikishi) via disqualification at 3:16 when Rikishi interfered, superkicked Bubba Ray, and hit the Rikishi Driver on D-Von; moments earlier, the Mean Street Posse – who came out before the match – attacked Rikishi at ringside but were soon chased backstage by the Acolytes

Kurt Angle defeated Kane (w/ Tori) via disqualificaton at 3:27 when Steve Blackman came into the ring and hit Angle over the head with his kendo stick; earlier in the show, Triple H told Blackman that if he attacked Kane in an attempt to save Angle's undefeated streak then he would be fired

WWF IC Champion Chyna (w/ the Kat) pinned Hardcore Holly (w/ Crash Holly) at 1:58 when Chris Jericho, who did guest commentary for the bout, punched Holly in the face, allowing Chyna to roll him up in a sunset flip for the win; prior to the bout, Stephanie McMahon had both Jericho and Chyna come out to the ring and declared that, as a result of their match on Smackdown!, both wrestlers were the Intercontinental Champion; both could defend the title but if one lost the title then both would lose it; moments later, Hardcore Holly, with Crash, came out and demanded a title shot; after the bout, Jericho left ringside with the title belt, with Chyna & Miss Kitty following, as Crash and Hardcore fought into the crowd

Triple H pinned WWF World Champion the Big Show to win the title at 7:08 with a kick to the groin and the Pedigree as the referee was distracted by X-Pac and the New Age Outlaws on the rampway; DX and Stephanie McMahon watched the match from stage; after the bout, balloons were dropped from the rafters and pyro went off to celebrate Triple H's victory as he was congratulated by DX and Stephanie in the ring

notes: mystery partners chosen by Triple H & Stephanie McMahon
matches.line: The Big Bossman & Albert defeated Test, the Fabulous Moolah (w/ Harvey Wippleman), & Mae Young (w/ Mark Henry) (mystery partners chosen by Triple H & Stephanie McMahon) in a handicap match at 1:41 when Albert pinned Test with the bicycle kick after Bossman used his nightstick to knock Test off the top; after the bout, Test and Wippleman were beaten down until Henry helped clear the ring

The Acolytes (with one arm tied behind their backs) defeated Pete Gas, Rodney, & Joey Abs via disqualification in a handicap match at the 30-second mark when the Dudley Boyz interfered and helped in beating down the Acolytes with a chair until a number of referees swarmed the ring

Jeff Hardy (w/ Terri & Matt Hardy) defeated Al Snow in a steel cage match at 6:45 by escaping over the top after leaping off Snow's back; prior to the bout, Snow attacked Matt from behind on the floor; moments later, he dragged Hardy out of the cage and assaulted him with a steel chair before throwing him back inside the ring and trapping Terri in the ring as well, locking the cage door with his own chain; after the match, Matt climbed over the top of the cage and hit Snow with a chair to save Terri

The Rock defeated X-Pac, WWF Tag Team Champions Billy Gunn & the Road Dogg in a No DQ handicap match at 9:17 by pinning Gunn with the Rock Bottom after Mick Foley came out of the crowd and assaulted Gunn, Road Dogg, X-Pac, & Triple H with a steel chair; prior to the bout, Triple H – who watched the match from the stage with Stephanie McMahon – announced that it would be a No DQ match; pre-match stipulations stated that had Rock lost, he would have been fired
WWF Tag Team Champion the Road Dogg pinned WWF Tag Team Champion Billy Gunn at 4:25 by reversing the Fameasser into a pumphandle slam
Matt & Jeff Hardy defeated Kurt Angle & Steve Blackman at 2:48 when Matt pinned Blackman
WWF European Champion Val Venis pinned Edge at 3:34 with the fisherman's suplex; after the match, the two along with Christian hugged because of Edge's engagement to Val's sister
Hardcore & Crash Holly defeated Chris Jericho & Chyna when Hardcore pinned Chyna at 2:47 after Jericho failed to notice Chyna reaching for the tag
WWF World Champion Triple H (w/ Stephanie McMahon) pinned X-Pac at 3:11 after Stephanie caused X-Pac to crotch himself on the top rope
Rikishi & Too Cool defeated Al Snow & the Headbangers when Rikishi pinned Mosh at 2:28 with the Rikishi Driver
D-Lo Brown & the Godfather defeated the Dudley Boyz via count-out at 3:20 when the Dudleyz tried to steal the hoes from ringside
The Big Show & Test defeated the Big Bossman & Prince Albert when Test pinned Albert at the 55 second mark

WWF World Champion Triple H, X-Pac, & WWF Tag Team Champions the Road Dogg & Billy Gunn defeated the Rock, Mankind, & the Acolytes when Triple H pinned Mankind after hitting him with the ring bell, a Pedigree through the commentary table, and a second Pedigree in the ring
Test pinned WWF Hardcore Champion the Big Bossman to win the title with the flying elbowdrop after Albert attacked the champion
Kurt Angle pinned Steve Blackman after Davey Boy Smith interfered and hit Blackman with his own kendo stick
The Acolytes defeated WWF World Champion Triple H & X-Pac (w/ Stephanie McMahon) via disqualification when the New Age Outlaws interfered
Jeff Hardy (w/ Terri Runnels & Matt Hardy) pinned Bubba Ray Dudley (w/ D-Von Dudley) with the Senton; after the bout, the Dudley Boyz hit the 3D on both Hardyz before putting them through tables

Rikishi defeated WWF IC Champion Chris Jericho via disqualification after Chyna, Crash, & Hardcore Holly interfered and Hardcore hit the challenger with a chair; after the bout, Too Cool made the save for Rikishi
Kane (w/ Tori) pinned Albert with the chokeslam

WWF Tag Team Champions Billy Gunn & the Road Dogg defeated the Rock & the Big Show when Gunn pinned Show after the Rock hit his partner with a chair; after the bout, the Rock hit the People's Elbow on Show
Edge & Christian fought Steve Blackman & Al Snow to a no contest after Edge suffered an injury from a double team legdrop; after the bout, EMTs were called to the ring
WWF IC Champion Chris Jericho pinned Hardcore Holly with the Lionsault after Chyna interfered and hit the Pedigree on the challenger onto a steel chair
Viscera & Crash Holly defeated Too Cool when Viscera pinned Grandmaster Sexay with a legdrop moments after Grandmaster hit the Tennessee Jam on Crash, the illegal man
Kane (w/ Tori) defeated X-Pac via disqualification after X-Pac used a chair

Matt & Jeff Hardy (w/ Terri Runnels) defeated WWF Tag Team Champions Billy Gunn & the Road Dogg via disqualification when the Dudley Boyz prevented the pinfall from being made after Jeff hit the Senton; after the bout, the Dudleyz hit the 3D on both Hardyz and Bubba Ray powerbombed Terri off the top through a table; Terri was later taken out of the ring on a stretcher
The Acolytes defeated the Godfather & D-Lo Brown when Bradshaw pinned D-Lo with the Clothesline from Hell
The Big Bossman defeated WWF Hardcore Champion Test in a non-title match via disqualification after Test used the Bossman's nightstick as a weapon

The Rock & Rikishi defeated WWF World Champion Triple H (w/ Stephanie McMahon) & the Big Show via disqualification when the New Age Outlaws interfered; after the bout, Cactus Jack made the save with a 2×4

notes: the surprise TV debut of Benoit, Malenko, Saturn, and Guerrero
matches.line: WWF Tag Team Champions Billy Gunn & the Road Dogg fought Al Snow & Steve Blackman to a no contest at 5:00 when the Road Dogg started a fight with Chris Benoit, Dean Malenko, Perry Saturn, and Eddie Guerrero, who were all sitting ringside for the show, by shoving Benoit after landing in their laps during the match; after the bout, Road Dogg was assaulted on the floor by Benoit and Malenko while, inside the ring, Gunn sustained an overhead suplex from Saturn and the Frog Splash from Guerrero; moments later, Malenko hit a suplex on Road Dogg inside the ring, with Benoit following with the diving headbutt off the top; during the segment, Jim Ross referred to the four men for the first time as the Radicalz (the surprise TV debut of Benoit, Malenko, Saturn, and Guerrero)

Christian (w/ Edge) pinned D-Von Dudley (w/ Bubba Ray Dudley) following the inverted DDT at 3:21; Matt & Jeff Hardy made the save for Edge & Christian after the match by putting the Dudleyz through tables
The Big Show defeated Too Cool in a handicap match at 2:15 after chokeslamming Grandmaster Sexay and powerbombing Scotty 2 Hotty

The Rock pinned Kurt Angle with the People's Elbow at 5:32 after Tazz stopped Angle from leaving and thew him back into the ring; after the match, Tazz went to clothesline Angle but accidentally hit the Rock instead; this was the first official pinfall loss for Angle
X-Pac (w/ Tori) pinned WWF IC Champion Chris Jericho (w/ Chyna) in a non-title match at 5:34 with the X-Factor after Tori hit Jericho with the title belt as X-Pac was in the Walls of Jericho

Harvina (Harvey Wippleman dressed as a woman) pinned WWF Women's Champion the Kat in a lumberjill match to win the title at 1:14 after Jackie knocked down the champion; other lumberjills included: BB, Ivory, Luna, Mae Young, and the Fabulous Moolah
Hardcore & Crash Holly defeated Viscera in a handicap match at 4:51 after Hardcore dropkicked Crash ontop of Viscera for the pin

Bubba Ray Dudley (w/ D-Von & the Acolytes) defeated Matt Hardy (w/ Jeff Hardy) via disqualification at 2:57 when Matt intercepted a chair from D-Von and hit Bubba with it; after the match, the Dudleyz and Acolytes destroyed the Hardyz and Edge & Christian
WWF World Champion Triple H (w/ Stephanie McMahon) defeated Cactus Jack (sub. for Kane) via disqualification when the Radicalz and Cactus ganged up on the champion
WWF Tag Team Champions the Road Dogg & Billy Gunn defeated Edge & Christian after the Dudley Boyz interfered and Road Dogg pinned Christian
Kurt Angle defeated Mark Henry via disqualification when Mae Young interfered; Angle hit the Olympic Slam on Mae after the match
Hardcore & Crash Holly defeated the Acolytes in a hardcore match after Viscera interfered as the two teams were brawling at a concession stand
WWF IC Champion Chris Jericho defeated Viscera via disqualification when the Hollys interfered; the Acolytes made the save after the match
WWF Women's Champion Jackie pinned Luna (w/ Gangrel) with a German suplex; Gangrel hit the DDT on Jackie after the match
The Dudley Boyz defeated the Godfather & D-Lo Brown following the 3D on D-Lo; the Hardy Boyz and Edge & Christian fend off the Dudleyz after the match

WWF World Champion Triple H (w/ Stephanie McMahon), X-Pac (w/ Tori), Chris Benoit, Perry Saturn, & Dean Malenko (w/ Eddie Guerrero) defeated the Rock, Cactus Jack, Too Cool, & Rikishi at 10:10 when Benoit pinned Grandmaster Sexay with the diving headbutt after Triple H hit the Pedigree; after the bout, Billy Gunn & the Road Dogg aided their DX teammates as well as the Radicalz in attacking the opposition until Kane made his return, alongside Paul Bearer, and made the save; Stephanie McMahon did guest commentary for the match

D-Von Dudley (w/ Bubba Ray Dudley) defeated Edge (w/ Christian) and Jeff Hardy (w/ Matt Hardy) by pinning Edge with a reverse DDT; due to prematch stipulations, the Dudleyz became the #1 contenders to the tag team titles
WWF Tag Team Champion the Road Dogg pinned Grandmaster Sexay with the pumphandle slam
The Godfather & D-Lo Brown defeated Steve Blackman & Al Snow when D-Lo pinned Blackman with a roll up as Snow danced with the hos on the floor
Chris Benoit (w/ Eddie Guerrero) pinned the Rock with a German suplex into a bridge after the Big Show interfered
Scotty 2 Hotty pinned WWF Tag Team Champion Billy Gunn
WWF Light Heavyweight Champion Essa Rios (w/ Lita) pinned Crash Holly (w/ Hardcore Holly) with the moonsault; after the match, Lita hit her own moonsault on Crash
Tazz defeated Hardcore Holly via disqualification when Crash Holly interfered to break the Tazzmission; after the match, Tazz hit a Tazzplex on Crash
Rikishi defeated Dean Malenko & Perry Saturn via disqualification in a handicap match after Eddie Guerrero interfered and hit Rikishi in the ankle with a pipe; after the match, Too Cool made the save
Kane fought WWF World Champion Triple H, X-Pac, & the Big Show to a no contest when the Rock and Cactus Jack interfered on behalf of Kane, forcing the opposition to head backstage

WWF European Champion Kurt Angle & Davey Boy Smith defeated WWF IC Champion Chris Jericho & Chyna at 2:48 when Angle pinned Jericho with the Olympic Slam after hitting him with the IC belt as Smith, the illegal man, was caught in the Walls of Jericho

Too Cool defeated Al Snow & Steve Blackman when Scotty 2 Hotty pinned Blackman at 3:11 with a roll up off the ropes, knocking Snow off the apron, into a bridge; during the bout, Chris Benoit, Perry Saturn, and Dean Malenko were shown watching the match backstage
Dean Malenko & Perry Saturn defeated the Godfather & D-Lo Brown at 3:39 when Saturn, the illegal man, pinned D-Lo with an elbow drop off the top

Edge, Christian, Matt & Jeff Hardy defeated the Dudley Boyz & WWF Tag Team Champions Billy Gunn & the Road Dogg at 8:18 when Jeff pinned Gunn with the Swanton after Gunn sustained a chairshot to the head from Bubba Ray as tensions flared between all four teams

The Acolytes & Mark Henry defeated Crash & Hardcore Holly & Viscera at 3:17 when Farooq pinned Crash with one hand following a spike powerbomb; after the match, Mae Young came out and began stomping Crash until Hardcore knocked her down and Viscera followed with a splash; moments later, Mae was taken backstage on a stretcher and transported to a medical facility

Chris Benoit pinned Test at 2:28 with a back suplex and the diving headbutt after Eddie Guerrero came ringside and hit Test from behind with a wrench; during the bout, Dean Malenko and Perry Saturn were shown watching the match backstage

Rikishi pinned Eddie Guerrero at the 22-second mark with the Bonzai Drop in a No DQ match after hitting Guerrero over the head with Rikishi's own crutches; after the bout, Too Cool came out to help Rikishi clear the ring of Perry Saturn, Chris Benoit, and Dean Malenko, with Rikishi eventually hitting the Rikishi Driver on Saturn; Guerrero wore a sling on his arm after injuring it several weeks prior and Rikishi came out to the ring on crutches after the Radicalz assaulted him on Smackdown!; after clearing the ring, Rikishi & Too Cool danced in the ring

Tazz defeated the Big Bossman via disqualification at 1:26 when Bossman grabbed his nightstick and used it to beat Tazz off him as the Tazzmission was applied; after the bout, Albert came out to help in double teaming Tazz, eventually hitting a fireman's carry into a swinging neckbreaker

WWF World Champion Triple H (w/ Stephanie McMahon), the Big Show, & X-Pac (w/ Tori) defeated the Rock, Cactus Jack, & Kane (w/ Paul Bearer) at 10:54 when Triple H pinned Cactus after hitting him with a fire extinguisher inside the ring; after the bout, all six men brawled on the floor near the entrance ramp until Cactus chased Triple H and Stephanie onto the DX Express, with Cactus driving a steel rod through the windowsheild before the bus drove off
Matt & Jeff Hardy defeated the Acolytes at 3:57 when Matt pinned Bradshaw with a kick to the midsection and the Twist of Fate after Jeff made the blind tag

Rikishi defeated WWF IC & European Champion Kurt Angle via count-out at 1:39 when Angle left the ring after sustaining the Stinkface; prior to the bout, Angle made an open challenge in the ring for anyone to face him, which Rikishi accepted; immediately after the bout, Chris Jericho came out with Chyna and threw Angle back inside the ring where Rikishi hit the Rikishi Driver and Bonzai Drop; moments later, Chris Benoit, Eddie Guerrero, Dean Malenko, and Perry Saturn attacked Jericho, Rikishi, and Chyna, with Too Cool eventually coming out to make the save; moments later, Rikishi, Too Cool, Jericho, and Chyna danced in the ring; only the Euro title was on the line

Edge & Christian (w/ Terri) defeated Al Snow & Steve Blackman at 3:23 when Edge pinned Blackman with the spear after Christian hit a missile dropkick while Blackman was distracted by Terri wearing the Head Cheese hat on the floor; prior to the bout, Terri came down to be in Edge & Christian's corner and do guest commentary; during their entrance, Al Snow debuted Steve Blackman's entrance music, which was put together to better portray his personality

The Rock pinned the Brooklyn Brawler with the Rock Bottom at the 31-second mark after an Irish whip; after the bout, the Rock grabbed a microphone and called Triple H out; Shane & Stephanie McMahon, Triple H, and the Big Show then came out, with Stephanie saying Rock could get a WrestleMania world title shot if he could pin either Triple H or Show in a handicap match later in the night

Chris Jericho (w/ Chyna) pinned Perry Saturn (w/ Dean Malenko) with the Lionsault at 3:03 after Chyna interfered behind the referee's back and hit a low blow on Saturn (Saturn and Malenko's MSG debut)

Mark Henry (w/ Mae Young) fought WWF Hardcore Champion Crash Holly to a no contest at around the 1:50 mark after Mae hit a splash on Crash inside the ring and doubled over in pain; moments later, EMTs came to the ring along with Pat Patterson, Gerald Brisco, and the Fabulous Moolah and helped Mae onto a stretcher and to the back; later in the show, Mae gave birth to her baby, which turned out to be a hand

Tazz defeated Chris Benoit via disqualification at 2:03 when the Big Bossman and Albert attacked Tazz as Benoit was caught in the Tazzmission; Eddie Guerrero was in Benoit's corner at the beginning of the match but was ejected by the referee mid-way through the bout; after the match, Tazz was double teamed by Bossman and Albert, eventually sustaining the Baldo Bomb and then a torture rack into a neckbreaker from Albert; moments later, Bossman cut a promo on the microphone as officials came in the ring to check on Tazz (Benoit and Guerrero's MSG debut)

WWF Tag Team Champions the Dudley Boyz fought X-Pac & the Road Dogg (w/ Tori) to a no contest at around 4:30 when Kane and Paul Bearer came to the ring, with Kane hitting the chokeslam on Road Dogg, D-Von, and Bubba Ray as a sign to what he planned to do to X-Pac

The Rock defeated WWF World Champion Triple H (w/ Stephanie McMahon) & the Big Show (w/ Shane McMahon) in a handicap match via disqualification at 6:53 when Shane broke Rock's cover on Triple H after hitting the People's Elbow; after the bout, Rock sustained a low blow from Shane, was beaten down by Triple H, and took a chokeslam from Big Show; pre-match stipulations stated that had Rock earned the pinfall, he would have received a world title match at WrestleMania

The Big Show (w/ Shane McMahon) defeated Kane (w/ Paul Bearer) via disqualification at 3:31 when the Rock ran in the ring and dropped Show with the Rock Bottom; after the bout, Kane hit the chokeslam on Show

Mark Henry (w/ Mae Young) pinned WWF Tag Team Champion D-Von Dudley (w/ Bubba Ray Dudley) with a powerslam at 1:15; after the match, the Dudleyz dropped Henry with the 3D and Bubba dropped Mae with a top rope powerbomb through a table set up in the ring
X-Pac & the Road Dogg (w/ Tori) defeated Too Cool via disqualification at 4:20 when Kane, with Paul Bearer, appeared and laid out both members of DX

Chris Jericho defeated WWF IC & European Champion Kurt Angle via disqualification at 4:09 when Bob Backlund came through the crowd and applied the Crossface Chicken Wing on Jericho as Angle was caught in the Walls of Jericho; after the bout, Backlund kept the hold applied until referees and officials pulled him away; moments later, Angle held up Backlund's hand in victory and the two left ringside together; only the IC title was on the line in the match

Rikishi defeated WWF World Champion Triple H (w/ Stephanie McMahon) via disqualification at 5:07 when Stephanie slid a steel chair in the ring and distracted referee Earl Hebner as Rikishi attempted the Bonzai Drop, with the champion then hitting Rikishi in the back with the chair; during the bout, Shane McMahon & the Big Show were shown watching backstage; after the match, the Rock ran in the ring and dropped the champion with the Rock Bottom and left ringside as Rikishi hit the Bonzai Drop on Triple H; moments later, Too Cool and Rikishi danced in the ring

Steve Blackman (w/ Al Snow) pinned Matt Hardy (w/ Jeff Hardy) with a kick to the chest off the top at 4:43 after shoving Matt off the top; prior to the bout, Snow told a stage hand backstage to arrange for Blackman to come out with midgets and platters of cheese but Blackman went to the stage hand without Snow knowing and threatened he would beat the guy up if that happened; during the ring introductions, Lillian Garcia announced Jeff would be wrestling the bout, when it was actually Matt

Dean Malenko & Perry Saturn (w/ Eddie Guerrero) defeated Edge & Christian (w/ Terri) 5:13 when Saturn pinned Christian following a modified Total Elimination as Terri, who did guest commentary for the bout, distracted Edge on the floor
WWF Hardcore Champion Crash Holly pinned Viscera backstage at 2:51 after Farooq smashed his chair over Viscera backstage after the fight interrupted the Acolytes' poker game

The Rock defeated Chris Benoit in a steel cage match at 10:52 by escaping over the top after fighting off WWF World Champion Triple H, who climbed up to meet Rock at the top of the cage, and knocking Triple H onto the Big Show outside the ring; prior to the bout, Benoit was escorted out by Dean Malenko, Perry Saturn, & Eddie Guerrero but he told them to go backstage; early in the bout, Show & Shane came ringside, with Triple H & Stephanie appearing moments later; after the match, Triple H accidentally hit Show with a chair while double teaming the Rock in the cage, with Rock then chasing Shane out of the cage before leaving ringside
Matt & Jeff Hardy defeated Al Snow & Steve Blackman when Matt pinned Blackman with an inside cradle at 3:20 immediately after Matt missed a top rope standing moonsault

Mark Henry fought WWF Tag Team Champions the Dudley Boyz to a no contest in a handicap match at around the 4-minute mark when, after hitting the 3D on Henry, the Dudleyz pushed the wheelchair-bound Mae Young to the top of the stage where Bubba Ray then hit a sit-down powerbomb from the stage through a table on the floor; earlier in the bout, Bubba Ray went backstage and found Mae in the dressing room, then brought her ringside; after the bout, Mae was attended to by Henry and EMTs, with her eventually being taken away in an ambulance; later in the broadcast, the Fabulous Moolah – who was supposed to be watching Mae in the dressing room – called Mae a bitch and said Mae had been trying to steal her spotlight

WWF European & IC Champion Kurt Angle defeated Chris Jericho and Tazz in a No DQ match at 3:14 by pinning Jericho after hitting him in the face with the Euro title belt immediately after Jericho hit a springboard dropkick to send Tazz to the floor; as Tazz made his way to the ring, Tazz demanded the No DQ stipulation; moments prior to the finish, Chyna came to the ring to counter the interference of Bob Backlund; only the European title was on the line

WWF World Champion Triple H (w/ Stephanie McMahon), the Road Dogg, & X-Pac (w/ Tori) defeated Rikishi & Too Cool when Triple H pinned Rikishi at 5:03 after X-Pac hit Rikishi in the face with the timekeeper's bell as Rikishi attempted the Bonzai Drop
Kane pinned the Big Bossman with the chokeslam at 3:13 after avoiding being hit by Bossman's nightstick

Dean Malenko (w/ Eddie Guerrero) pinned WWF Light Heavyweight Champion Essa Rios (w/ Lita) to win the title at 4:15 by blocking a victory roll moments after Guerrero caught Lita coming off the apron with a hurricanrana and hit a powerbomb to the floor

The Acolytes (w/ Mideon) defeated Edge & Christian at 3:06 when Bradshaw pinned Edge with the Clothesline from Hell immediately after Edge hit the spear on an interfering Mideon; Terri, who came ringside before the bout began, distracted Christian during the cover so that he could not make the save; after the bout, Edge & Christian double clotheslined Mideon out of the ring

Chris Benoit & Perry Saturn defeated Test & Val Venis at 4:25 when Benoit pinned Test with a German suplex into a bridge after Eddie Guerrero, who was on the ring apron, hit Test in the face; Guerrero came ringside mid-way through the bout

The Rock pinned the Big Show with the Rock Bottom at 9:16, moments after Vince McMahon arrived to the arena, knocked down Triple H backstage, then came to the ring, hit guest referee Shane McMahon over the head with a steel chair, and put on Shane's referee shirt to declare himself the new referee; prior to the bout, Shane McMahon came ringside and told referee Earl Hebner to leave the ring as he was the guest referee for the bout; due to prematch stipulations, Rock earned a world title shot for WrestleMania; had Rock not won, he would have had to quit the WWF

Matt & Jeff Hardy defeated X-Pac & the Road Dogg (w/ Tori) after Jeff hit the Swanton on Road Dogg moments after Kane scared X-Pac from ringside; due to prematch stipulations, the Hardyz earned a spot in the battle royal later in the night that would deterine the #1 contendes to the tag team titles
The Godfather fought the Big Bossman (w/ Bull Buchanon) to a no contest when Bossman and Bull double teamed Godfather before the bout began

Too Cool defeated Perry Saturn & Dean Malenko (w/ Eddie Guerrero) after Grandmaster Sexay kicked Malenko as Malenko had the Texas Cloverleaf applied on Scotty 2 Hotty; due to prematch stipulations, Too Cool earned a spot in the battle royal later in the night that would deterine the #1 contendes to the tag team titles
Kane (w/ Paul Bearer) defeated Rikishi via disqualification when the Road Dogg & X-Pac attacked Kane; Rikishi attempted to make the save but was also beaten down
Chris Jericho pinned Chris Benoit with the Lionsault; after the bout, Kurt Angle and Bob Backlund attacked both participants

Al Snow & Steve Blackman defeated WWF Hardcore Champion Crash Holly & Hardcore Holly following the double team Snow legdrop off the top on Hardcore after Tazz fought Crash backstage in an attempt to win the Hardcore title; due to prematch stipulations, Snow & Blackman earned a spot in the battle royal later in the night that would deterine the #1 contendes to the tag team titles

Edge & Christian defeated the Acolytes when Edge pinned Farooq after Mideon's interference backfired; due to prematch stipulations, Edge & Christian earned a spot in the battle royal later in the night that would deterine the #1 contendes to the tag team titles

Test (w/ Trish Stratus) pinned Val Venis with a roll up and holding the tights for leverage; after the bout, Albert came ringside and helped in double teaming Val; after the bout, Trish announced the formation of T&A

Matt & Jeff Hardy fought Edge & Christian to a no contest in a 4-team #1 contenders tag team battle royal when the Dudley Boyz, who were doing guest commentary, attacked both teams; eliminations included: Too Cool were eliminated by the Hardyz and Snow & Blackman were eliminated by the Hardyz; after the bout, the Dudleyz hit the 3D on Edge and Matt Hardy and powerbombed Jeff off the top onto Christian set up on a table

WWF World Champion Triple H (w/ Stephanie McMahon) defeated the Rock (w/ Vince McMahon) and the Big Show (w/ Shane McMahon) by pinning Show with the Pedigree; after the bout, Linda McMahon announced that the main event at WrestleMania 2000 would be a four-way match involving Mick Foley; as the show came to a close, Foley attacked Triple H as the Rock chased Shane McMahon through the crowd

Chris Benoit & Eddie Guerrero defeated Chris Jericho & Chyna at 1:55 when Benoit pinned Jericho after Guerrero tripped Jericho as he attempted the Lionsault; after the bout, Jericho and Benoit fought their way into the crowd while Chyna stalked Guerrero around ringside; moments later, Dean Malenko and Perry Saturn came out and helped in triple teaming Chyna until Too Cool made the save and cleared the ring

WWF Hardcore Champion Crash Holly fought Hardcore Holly to a no contest at the 2-minute mark when, after Tazz, the Mean Street Posse, the Headbangers, Taka Michinoku, Sho Funaki, and Viscera involved themselves in the match, Crash was chased out of the arena where he eventually snuck back in and locked all the other wrestlers outside
Rikishi defeated the Road Dogg via count-out at 1:01 when Road Dogg left ringside after sustaining the Stinkface; after the bout, Too Cool came out, with all three men then dancing in the ring

WWF Light Heavyweight Champion Dean Malenko & Perry Saturn defeated Matt & Jeff Hardy at 5:45 when Saturn pinned Jeff with a double underhook suplex after Christian pulled Saturn out of the way of Jeff's Swanton and Edge hit the spear on Jeff; Edge & Christian did guest commentary for the bout

Kane (w/ Paul Bearer) defeated WWF European & IC Champion Kurt Angle via disqualification in a non-title match at 3:39 when Angle hit Kane in the face with the IC title belt after landing a low blow behind the referee's back; after the bout, Kane dragged Angle back inside the ring and hit the chokeslam and tombstone
Test (w/ Trish Stratus & Albert) pinned Al Snow (w/ Steve Blackman) at the 38-second mark with a boot to the face after Blackman attempted to throw Head into the ring but overshot the throw

The Acolytes fought the Big Bossman & Bull Buchanon to a no contest at around the 1:30 mark when the Godfather & D-Lo Brown came ringside, paid off the Acolytes, and cleared the ring of Bossman & Buchanon

X-Pac (w/ Tori & the Road Dogg) pinned WWF Tag Team Champion D-Von Dudley (w/ WWF Tag Team Champion Bubba Ray Dudley) at 2:24 with the X-Factor after Road Dogg dropped D-Von throat first across the top rope; after the bout, Bubba Ray and Road Dogg fought in the ring until Kane came out, with the Dudleyz hitting the 3D on him; moments later, Kane sat up and attempted a chokeslam on Tori only to sustain a low blow from X-Pac; moments later, X-Pac & Road Dogg threw Kane over the top rope and through a table that the Dudleyz had set up on the floor earlier in the match

The Rock & Vince McMahon defeated the Big Show & Shane McMahon at 11:10 when Rock pinned Shane with the Rock Bottom, moments after Vince knocked guest referee Triple H out of the ring and the second guest referee Mick Foley sent Show out of the ring

Eddie Guerrero pinned WWF European Champion Chris Jericho (w/ Chyna) to win the title at 5:38 when, after referee Tim White was knocked to the floor, Chyna counted Jericho's pin attempt on Guerrero only to then hit a low blow on the champion and drop him with a DDT before placing Guerrero on top; prior to the bout, Guerrero cut a promo on his way to the ring, saying he could tell Chyna wanted some “latino heat” but he had to put her aside to focus on winning the title and making his ancestors from Spain proud
X-Pac & the Road Dogg (w/ Tori) defeated Test & Albert (w/ Trish Stratus) when X-Pac pinned Albert with the X-Factor after a low blow by the Road Dogg
WWF IC Champion Chris Benoit pinned Tazz with a German suplex into a bridge after the challenger fought off Perry Saturn
The Big Show defeated Rikishi (w/ Too Cool) via disqualification when Too Cool interfered

Crash Holly pinned WWF Hardcore Champion Hardcore Holly to win the title after the challenger paid off the Acolytes to interfere and they hit a double spinebuster on Hardcore; after the match, Crash escaped the challenge of the Mean Street Posse by running away
Kurt Angle defeated Val Venis via submission to the Crossface Chicken Wing
Kane (w/ Paul Bearer) pinned Bull Buchanon (w/ the Big Bossman) with the chokeslam
The Rock defeated Shane McMahon (w/ Vince McMahon) by pinning an interfering WWF World Champion Triple H with the Rock Bottom

WWF Tag Team Champions Edge & Christian defeated X-Pac & the Road Dogg (w/ Tori) at 3:08 when Edge pinned X-Pac with the spear; the challengers originally won the match and the titles after hitting Christian with the ring bell but Earl Hebner nullified the desicion and ordered that the match continue
Kurt Angle pinned the Godfather with the Olympic Slam at 2:03
WWF IC Champion Chris Benoit, Dean Malenko, & Perry Saturn defeated Tazz, Rikishi, & Scotty 2 Hotty when Malenko pinned Scotty at 3:52
WWF World Champion Triple H pinned Taka Michinoku (w/ Sho Funaki & the Acolytes) following the Pedigree at 5:53 after the Big Bossman & Bull Buchanon attacked the Acolytes
