Matt & Jeff Hardy defeated Test & Albert (w/ Trish Stratus) at 3:08 following the Twist of Fate and Swanton on Albert; the Dudleyz came to the ring afterwards, with Bubba Ray being distracted by Trish and put through a table
Val Venis defeated the Big Show via disqualification at 2:29 when Show began choking Val with his Val Venis wig
WWF European Champion Eddie Guerrero (w/ Chyna) pinned Chris Jericho at 5:19 after Chyna interfered and hit a low blow and a DDT

The Rock defeated Bull Buchanon & the Big Bossman in a handicap steel cage match at 7:11 by pinning Bull with the Rock Bottom; the Acolytes made the save for Rock against the McMahons, Triple H, Bossman, and Bull after the match; due to prematch stipulations, Rock earned a world title shot at Backlash

Chris Jericho pinned WWF World Champion Triple H (w/ WWF Women's Champion Stephanie McMahon) with a spin kick and the Lionsault at 8:38; prior to the bout, Jericho challenged Triple H to put the title on the line, as the match was originally a non-title contest, and then brought out the Acolytes to be in his corner; late in the bout, Shane McMahon, who was at ringside, crotched Jericho on the top rope after referee Mike Chioda had been knocked out, with the APA then chasing Shane to the back; Earl Hebner came down moments later to take over the officiating; after the commercial break, Chioda and Hebner were dragged back to the ring where Chioda was pressured into saying Hebner gave a fast count; Triple H then threatened Hebner to reverse the decision or else, with Hebner then saying he would only reverse the decision if Triple H and the McMahons agreed to never lay their hands on him again, as long as he was a WWF official; Triple H agreed, Jericho came out onto the stage, and reluctantly relinquished the title belt; Hebner returned to the ring, strapped it around Triple H's waist, and was then publicly fired and beaten down by Triple H and Shane, eventually sustaining the Pedigree before numerous officials swarmed the ring

Matt & Jeff Hardy defeated Essa Rios (w/ Lita) & WWF European Champion Eddie Guerrero (w/ Chyna) at 4:43 when Matt pinned Guerrero with the Twist of Fate after Lita accidentally hit a moonsault onto a standing Guerrero; after the bout, Chyna hit a powerbomb on Essa while Guerrero stomped him

WWF Hardcore Champion Crash Holly defeated Perry Saturn and ECW World Champion Tazz at 3:25 by pinning Saturn after dropkicking an interfering Hardcore Holly in the face seconds after Hardcore hit the Hollycaust on Saturn; after the bout, Lilian Garcia mistakenly announced Crash as the WWF Champion (Tazz' first appearance on WWF TV as ECW Champion)

Al Snow & Steve Blackman defeated the Dudley Boyz at 1:32 when Snow pinned D-Von after Test hit the flying elbow onto D-Von as Trish Stratus and Albert distracted the referee, moments after the Dudleyz hit the 3D on Snow; after the bout, Bubba Ray grabbed Trish by the hair but Trish kissed Bubba on the lips to distract him long enough so she could escape being put through a table
Scotty 2 Hotty pinned WWF Light Heavyweight Champion Dean Malenko to win the title at 4:42 with a cradle immediately after Malenko hit a superplex on the challenger

The Big Show defeated WWF IC Champion Chris Benoit via disqualification at 2:18 when Benoit kicked Show in the groin to escape the chokeslam; after the bout, Kurt Angle ran to the ring and repeatedly stomped and elbowed Show in the groin

WWF Tag Team Champions Edge & Christian defeated the Big Bossman & Bull Buchanon via disqualification at 4:41 when, as the challengers were double teaming in the ring, Bossman shoved referee Teddy Long; after the bout, Kane came out, knocked Bossman from the ring, and hit a chokeslam on Buchanon; after the commercial break, Edge & Christian were jumped backstage and knocked out by X-Pac & the Road Dogg

WWF World Champion Triple H, the Road Dogg, & X-Pac (w/ Shane McMahon, WWF Women's Champion Stephanie McMahon, & Tori) defeated Chris Jericho & the Acolytes at 7:37 with a kick to the midsection and the Pedigree after Jericho hit the corner; late in the bout, the Acolytes battled with Road Dogg & X-Pac up the ramp, where Edge & Christian came down to help gang up on the DX members; moments later, the Acolytes returned ringside but were jumped from behind by the Big Bossman & Bull Buchanon
Rikishi defeated Kurt Angle via disqualification at 1:23 when Angle pushed the referee to avoid the Stinkface; after the match, the Big Show assisted Rikishi in using the Stinkface on Angle

WWF IC Champion Chris Benoit pinned the Road Dogg (w/ Tori) at 3:13 with the flying headbutt after Edge and Christian interfered, with Edge hitting the spear on the challenger; after the match, Christian hit an inverted DDT on Tori
Hardcore Holly & WWF Hardcore Champion Crash Holly defeated Matt & Jeff Hardy at 2:38 when Hardcore pinned Jeff with an inside cradle after Crash hit Jeff with a cookie sheet prior to the Swanton
Matt Hardy pinned WWF Hardcore Champion Crash Holly after a Swanton from Jeff after outside interference from Perry Saturn, Jeff Hardy, and Tazz
The Big Show defeated the Big Bossman & Bull Buchanon via disqualification at 1:22 in a handicap match after Kurt Angle interfered; after the match, the Acolytes attacked Bossman and Buchanon
D-Lo Brown & Steve Blackman defeated the Godfather & Al Snow at 2:32 when D-Lo pinned Snow with the Lo Down
Val Venis pinned WWF European Champion Eddie Guerrero (w/ Chyna) in a non-title match at 3:41 with the Money Shot as Essa Rios and Lita attacked Chyna on the floor
WWF Tag Team Champions Edge & Christian defeated the Dudley Boyz at 4:36 after Edge hit the spear on D-Von as Bubba Ray was distracted by Trish Stratus on the apron

WWF World Champion Triple H & WWF IC Champion Chris Benoit defeated the Rock & Chris Jericho at 7:23 when Triple H pinned the Rock with the Pedigree, following a low blow by Vince McMahon; Shane McMahon was the special referee for the bout
Test & Albert defeated the Dudley Boyz at 4:49 when Test pinned D-Von after Edge & Christian interfered
WWF Hardcore Champion Crash Holly fought a parking attendant to a no contest when the champion ran away
Too Cool defeated Matt & Jeff Hardy at 4:50 when Grandmaster Sexay pinned Matt with the superkick
The Kat & Jackie defeated Terri Runnels & Ivory at 4:04 when Kat pinned Terri after Jackie interfered behind the referee's back

The Goodfather & Bull Buchanon defeated the Acolytes at 2:36 when Buchanon pinned Farooq with the axe kick; after the match, Val Venis attacked the Acolytes with a chair and joined the RTC

WWF European Champion Al Snow pinned Tazz at 1:28 with an inside cradle after Jerry Lawler interfered and hit Tazz over the head with a framed picture of David Hasselhoff; after the match, Tazz grabbed a mic, said he can't compete with Lawler's political power, and that he has become just another victim of the WWF

Kurt Angle fought Test & Albert (w/ Trish Stratus) to a no contest at 2:52 in a handicap match after Stephanie McMahon came ringside and attacked Trish, Triple H made the save for Stephanie, and Triple H accidentally knocked Stephanie out during a confrontation with Angle
WWF Hardcore Champion Steve Blackman pinned X-Pac at 3:27 after Chris Jericho interfered and hit the challenger with a kendo stick
Kane & Chris Benoit defeated WWF World Champion the Rock & the Undertaker in a No DQ match at 5:02 when Kane attacked Taker midway through the Last Ride, with Benoit falling on top for the pin

Bull Buchanon & the Goodfather (w/ Steven Richards & Val Venis) defeated the Dudley Boyz at 3:06 when Buchanon pinned Bubba Ray after Richards interfered and hit the Stevie Kick; after the match, all four members of the RTC attacked the Dudley Boyz until the Acolytes came out to help clear the ring

Kane defeated Chris Benoit via disqualification at 3:52 when Benoit twice hit his opponent with the ring bell and attacked the referee; after the bout, Benoit hit the diving headbutt on Kane, shoved the referee back down to the mat, and then left ringside as Kane sat up

Triple H, Kurt Angle, & Stephanie McMahon defeated Test, Albert, & Trish Stratus at 5:15 when Stephanie pinned Test after Triple H pushed Test off the top, shoved Trish from the apron to the floor, and hit the Pedigree on Test; after the bout, Triple H tackled Angle and knocked him out of the ring after seeing Angle enthusiastically hug Stephanie

Rikishi fought Chyna (sub. for an ill Eddie Guerrero) (w/ WWF IC Champion Eddie Guerrero) to a no contest when Guerrero interfered and sprayed mace in Rikishi's face before the match began; prior to the entrances, Tazz came out, sent Lilian Garcia out of the ring, and took over the ring announcing duties; after Guerrero's entrance, Rikishi attacked Guerrero on the floor, threw him into the ring steps, and threw him into the ring; moments later, Rikishi attacked Chyna to goad Eddie into the ring and hit the Bonzai Drop but Eddie wouldn't make the save; Taz announced Rikishi as the winner but did so under his own judgment, not the referee's; later in the show, it was announced Rikishi would face WWF IC Champion Eddie Guerrero at Unforgiven

WWF Tag Team Champions Edge & Christian defeated Too Cool at 4:01 when Edge pinned Grandmaster Sexay after hitting him with one of the title belts; during their ring entrances, Tazz announced Too Cool as “Two Fools” and said Edge & Christian were “from someplace in Canada”; Tazz harassed Lawler at ringside for the duration of the match but, because of the no tolerance clause which said they couldn't be physical with one another until Unforgiven, Lawler was unable to retaliate with force; after the bout, Tazz was escorted backstage by several officials

The Undertaker pinned WWF World Champion the Rock in a non-title match with the powerbomb at 4:23 after hitting an elbow to the head to block an attempt at the Rock Bottom; Chris Benoit did guest commentary for the bout; after the match, Kane came out to the ring, prompting Benoit to enter the ring as well and double team Taker; moments later, the Rock hit the Rock Bottom on Taker to win a brawl over the three other men
Kane fought Rikishi to a double disqualification at 2:02 when Kane pushed the referee as Rikishi attempted to use a steel chair; after the match, the two had to be pulled apart
Tazz pinned Bubba Ray Dudley at 4:01 after Raven interfered and hit the DDT on Bubba Ray
WWF Tag Team Champions Matt & Jeff Hardy defeated Edge & Christian in a ladder match at 11:24 after Lita interfered; stipulations stated it was Edge & Christian's only title shot against the Hardys
X-Pac defeated Chris Jericho in a First Blood Match at 2:50; after the match, Jericho applied the Walls of Jericho on X-Pac on top of the commentary table
WWF IC Champion Eddie Guerrero (w/ Chyna) pinned Val Venis (w/ Steven Richards) at 2:31 with a school boy roll up

WWF World Champion the Rock pinned Chris Benoit with the Rock Bottom at 7:34 after Triple H interfered; after the match, Benoit and Kurt Angle attacked the Rock and Triple H, with Benoit headbutting Stephanie McMahon

WWF Tag Team Champions Matt & Jeff Hardy (w/ Lita) defeated Too Cool (w/ Mandy & Victoria) when Jeff pinned Scotty 2 Hotty after interference from Edge backfired and he accidentally hit a spear on Scotty after Matt moved out of the way
Chris Jericho & the Dudley Boyz defeated Tazz, Raven, & X-Pac when Jericho pinned Raven with the Lionsault after the 3D
WWF World Champion the Rock & Rikishi defeated Kane & Chris Benoit when Rikishi pinned Kane with the sit-down splash after the Rock Bottom
WWF Hardcore Champion Steve Blackman defeated Edge and Christian at 3:16 by pinning Christian after pump kicking a steel chair into Christian's face
WWF IC Champion Eddie Guerrero & Chyna defeated Steven Richards & Val Venis

Kurt Angle pinned Triple H with the Angle Slam when Triple H became distracted after Chris Benoit pulled Stephanie McMahon off the ring apron; after the bout, an angry Triple H left Stephanie alone in the ring
WWF Women's Champion Lita pinned Jackie in a hardcore match at 3:53 after spraying her with a fire extinguisher and then hitting her over the head with a cookie sheet

WWF Hardcore Champion Steve Blackman pinned Raven in a non-title non-hardcore match with a kick to the chest; after the bout, Raven attacked the champion but was soon taken down by Blackman's kendo sticks
Chris Benoit & X-Pac defeated Triple H & Chris Jericho when Benoit pinned Triple H after Jericho sent X-Pac into the corner, which caused Triple H to be crotched on the top rope

WWF Tag Team Champions Matt & Jeff Hardy (w/ WWF Women's Champion Lita) defeated D-Lo Brown & Chaz when Jeff pinned D-Lo at 7:01; during the match, the Conquistadors interfered and stopped Jeff from hitting the Swanton (Conquistadors' debut / return); after the bout, Chaz hit Matt with one of the title belts

WWF European Champion Al Snow pinned Test (w/ Trish Stratus) at 4:42 by hitting him with Head after the challenger accidentally knocked Trish off the apron; William Regal did guest commentary for the match

Val Venis & the Goodfater (w/ Steven Richards) defeated WWF IC Champion Eddie Guerrero & Chyna at 4:29 when Venis pinned Guerrero with a gutwrench powerbomb; during the match, Chyna refused to tag in after watching GTV's footage of Eddie backstage with the hoes, Mandy & Victoria; after the bout, Billy Gunn made the save for Chyna against Venis, the Goodfather, and Steven Richards

WWF World Champion the Rock & Rikishi defeated Kurt Angle & Kane when Rikishi pinned Angle with the Bonzai Drop at 7:49 after Angle suffered the Rock Bottom; late in the match, Kane hit a chokeslam on his partner before walking out on the match; after the bout, Mick Foley came to the ring and rightly accused Rikishi of being the mystery man who ran over Steve Austin at the previous year's Survivor Series

Chris Jericho fought WWF IC Champion Eddie Guerrero to a no contest when the bout was stopped after the champion appeared to have injured his groin muscle; after the bout, Billy Gunn made the save for Jericho against X-Pac as Guerrero was taken from ringside on a stretcher (the stretcher was not shown on television)
The Acolytes defeated Test & Albert (w/ Trish Stratus) after Albert sustained Farooq's spinebuster and Bradshaw's Clothesline from Hell

William Regal defeated WWF European Champion Al Snow at 3:39 via submission with the Regal Stretch to win the title after blocking a moonsault; Snow came out to the ring dressed as though he was from England

Triple H defeated Kane via disqualification when Chris Benoit, who was doing guest commentary for the match, hit Triple H with a chair on the floor in retaliation to Triple H attacking him moments earlier; after the match, Benoit applied the Crippler Crossface on Triple H inside the ring; during the bout, Stephanie McMahon wanted to come to the ring and give moral support to her husband but Kurt Angle convinced her to stay backstage
X-Pac defeated Billy Gunn via disqualification when Chris Jericho interfered and attacked X-Pac, with the two brawling around ringside after the bout
The Conquistadors defeated the Dudley Boyz when Conquistador #2 pinned Bubba Ray with a roll up
Val Venis (w/ Steven Richards) pinned the Road Dogg following a low blow; during the bout, Naked Mideon ran into the ring and attacked Richards before leaving ringside

Kurt Angle (w/ Stephanie McMahon), Edge, & Christian defeated WWF World Champion the Rock, WWF Tag Team Champions Matt & Jeff Hardy when Angle scored the pin with the Olympic Slam; after the bout, the Rock hit the Rock Bottom on the tag team champions as Angle and Stephanie left ringside
WWF Women's Champion Lita defeated Trish Stratus in a Bra & Panties match at 2:09 after hitting the moonsault

Chris Benoit defeated the Road Dogg via submission with the Crippler Crossface at 2:05 after Road Dogg became distracted by Dean Malenko; prior to the match, Benoit cut an in-ring promo saying the only reason Triple H beat him the previous night was because of his “bitch” of a wife and that he would take his frustrations out on Triple H's friend Road Dogg; after the bout, Lilian Garcia flubbed and announced the winner as being Chris Jericho; during the match, it was announced several WWF superstars would be appearing throughout the week on ‘Regis & Kelly' to promote the new WWF cookbook; after the decision was announced, Benoit and Malenko shook hands in the ring

Chris Jericho defeated WWF European Champion William Regal via disqualification at 2:10 when Kane came ringside and hit the chokeslam on Jericho; prior to the bout, Regal cut an in-ring promo on the state producing so many handguns that are used to kill people; moments later, Jericho responded and was about to insult Regal but said Regal wasn't worth it and then ran into the ring
Tazz & Raven defeated Too Cool at 4:33 when Tazz pinned Scotty after Raven hit the DDT
Billy Gunn (w/ Chyna) pinned Val Venis (w/ Steven Richards) at 3:30 with the Fameasser

WWF Tag Team Champions the Conquistadors defeated Edge in a handicap match at 1:43 following the Swanton; after the bout, as Christian came to the ring to console his partner, the Conquistadors unmasked and were revealed as the Hardy Boyz; moments thereafter, Commissioner Mick Foley allowed both the previous night's controversial tag team title change as well as this switch

WWF World Champion Kurt Angle (w/ Stephanie McMahon) fought the Rock and Triple H to a no contest at 8:51 when Rikishi attacked the champion; after the bout, Steve Austin came to the ring and attacked both Rikishi and Angle

WWF IC Champion Eddie Guerrero (w/ the Kat, dressed as Chyna) pinned Chyna at 2:41 when Steven Richards interfered and hit the Steven Kick on the challenger after Chyna press slammed the Kat onto Guerrero; after the bout, Billy Gunn came out to make the save and cleared the ring

Bull Buchanon, the Goodfather, & Ivory (w/ Steven Richards) defeated WWF Women's Champion Lita, WWF Tag Team Champions Matt & Jeff Hardy at 4:59 when Ivory pinned Jeff after Richards interfered and hit the Steven Kick, moments after Hardy hit the Swanton

Test (w/ Trish Stratus) pinned Crash Holly in a hardcore match at 3:05 by placing Crash's head in a trash can, hitting it with a kendo stick, and hitting the flying elbowsmash; during the bout, Jim Ross & Jerry Lawler discussed that Adam Sandler would be appearing on Smackdown!

Steve Austin pinned Rikishi in a steel cage match at 5:14 with the Stunner after ramming Rikishi face-first into the cage; pre-match stipulations stated that the victory could only come via pinfall; prior to the bout, the two brawled around ringside before finally entering the cage

Steven Richards (w/ Val Venis) pinned Billy Gunn (w/ Chyna) at 2:24 after Eddie Guerrero interfered and hit Gunn with the IC title belt, moments after Gunn hit the Fameasser on his opponent; prior to the bout, Richards cut a promo in the ring stating that if he won the match, Gunn would no longer be able to use the term “Mr. Ass”; moments later, Gunn & Chyna came out, with Gunn accepting but only if the stipulation was added that if Richards lost, he would have to kiss Gunn's ass

WWF World Champion Kurt Angle defeated Triple H via disqualification in a non-title match at 5:53 when Triple H grabbed and shoved referee Tim White across the ring, moments after Triple H hit the Pedigree on Angle through the commentary table; after the bout, Triple H grabbed the microphone and said that if the crowd wanted a DQ, they would get a DQ; moments later, Triple H hit the Pedigree on White then hit Angle and an interfering Edge with a steel chair before hitting the Pedigree on Christian as well

The Rock pinned Chris Jericho at 7:10 with the Rock Bottom; after the match, Rikishi assaulted the Rock and threw Jericho to the floor before grabbing a microphone and stating that it was the Rock that helped and told him to run over Steve Austin during the previous year's Survivor Series; due to pre-match stipulations, Rock became the #1 contender to the world title and would receive a title shot on Smackdown!

The Undertaker pinned Val Venis at 5:09 with the powerbomb; after the match, the Undertaker pulled off his vest to reveal a Yokozuna t-shirt underneath in memory of Yoko who passed away weeks prior; had any member of the RTC interfered in the match, they would have lost their tag team title shot against the Hardyz later in the evening

Test & Albert (w/ Trish Stratus) defeated Too Cool at 3:53 when Test pinned Grandmaster Sexay after Albert interfered behind the referee's back and hit the Baldo Bomb; after the match, Crash & Molly Holly made the save

Triple H, Billy Gunn, Chyna, & the Road Dogg defeated Chris Benoit, Eddie Guerrero, Dean Malenko, & Perry Saturn at 5:11 when Triple H pinned Malenko with the Pedigree; after the match, Kurt Angle attacked Triple H while the Radicalz continued to attack their opponents

The Godfather & Bull Buchanon (w/ Steven Richards) defeated WWF Tag Team Champions Matt & Jeff Hardy to win the titles at 5:19 when Richards placed on of the tag belts on top of the Goodfather before Jeff hit a top rope move, allowing the Goodfather to score the pin; earlier in the match, Edge & Christian interfered but were quickly sent out of the ring by the champions

WWF Hardcore Champion Steve Blackman pinned Kane at 4:50 when Chris Jericho interfered and hit the challenger with a steel chair as Kane was holding up the steel ringsteps, causing them to crush him underneath and allowing the champion the easy pinfall
Jerry Lawler defeated Raven via disqualification at 1:31 when Tazz, who was doing guest commentary for the match, interfered; after the match, Al Snow made the save
The Dudley Boyz defeated Edge & Christian in a tables match at 3:31 when Christian was sent through a table with the 3D after the Hardy Boyz and Lita interfered

Steve Austin & Triple H fought WWF World Champion Kurt Angle & Rikishi to a no contest at 4:14 when Triple H, filling in for the Rock who had been attacked moments earlier backstage, nailed Austin with his sledgehammer after tossing Angle to the floor; moments later, Triple H admitted that it was he who was behind Austin's hit-and-run injury at the 1999 Survivor Series

WWF World Champion Kurt Angle defeated Crash Holly (w/ Molly Holly) via submission with the ankle lock at 2:55; after the match, Hardcore Holly made the save until Edge & Christian came ringside; the Undertaker eventually cleared the ring until Kurt Angle ran from ringside

Chris Jericho & WWF Hardcore Champion Steve Blackman defeated Kane & Test (w/ Trish Stratus) in a hardcore match at 3:57 when Jericho pinned Kane with the Lionsault after Test accidentally hit his partner with a kendo stick; after the bout, Kane hit a chokeslam on Test
The Dudley Boyz defeated Tazz & Raven at 5:02 with the 3D on Tazz after Raven accidentally hit his partner; after the bout, Tazz hit a Tazzplex on Raven through a table set up in the ring
The Undertaker, Hardcore & Crash Holly (w/ Molly Holly) defeated WWF World Champion Kurt Angle, Edge, & Christian at 6:46 when Taker pinned Angle with the powerbomb

Lita, Matt & Jeff Hardy defeated WWF Women's Champion Ivory & WWF Tag Team Champions the Goodfather & Bull Buchanon via disqualification at 3:56 when the Goodfather pulled the referee out of the ring to prevent a pinfall; after the bout, Val Venis joined in a brawl at ringside; both the tag team and women's titles were on the line in the match
WWF European Champion William Regal defeated the Road Dogg via disqualification at 2:41 when K-Kwick interfered and hit Regal with a microphone

Steve Austin, the Rock, Billy Gunn, & Chyna defeated Chris Benoit, WWF IC Champion Eddie Guerrero, WWF Light Heavyweight Champion Dean Malenko, & Perry Saturn (w/ Terri) at 10:45 when Austin pinned Guerrero with the Stunner; after the bout, the Rock continued brawling with Benoit backstage until Rikishi drove past and hit the Rock with a sledgehammer while hanging out the car window

The Dudley Boyz defeated WWF Tag Team Champions Bull Buchanon & the Goodfather (w/ Steven Richards) via disqualification at 4:20 when Richards pulled D-Von out of the ring to prevent a pinfall following the 3D; after the match, Richards was powerbombed through a table

WWF European Champion William Regal pinned Hardcore Holly in a hardcore match at 3:53 after hitting him in the head with a 2×4 after Test & Albert interfered; after the bout, Crash Holly and Steve Blackman made the save

The Rock & Chris Jericho defeated Rikishi & Kane at 8:29 when Rock pinned Kane with the Rock Bottom following a chairshot from Jericho; after the bout, Rock and Jericho continued to assault their opponents
Billy Gunn, the Road Dogg, & K-Kwick defeated WWF IC Champion Eddie Guerrero, WWF Light Heavyweight Champion Dean Malenko, & Perry Saturn (w/ Terri) at 4:11 when Kwick pinned Saturn with a 720 splash
WWF Women's Champion Ivory pinned Molly Holly at 1:34 after Trish Stratus interfered and dropped the challenger with a DDT on the floor

The Undertaker defeated Edge & Christian in a handicap match at 1:31 by pinning Christian with the powerbomb after Edge accidentally hit the spear on his partner; after the bout, Taker hit the chokeslam on Edge
Steve Austin pinned Chris Benoit at 8:34 with a kick to the mid-section and the Stunner after avoiding a clothesline
Hardcore, Crash, & Molly Holly defeated Trish Stratus, Test, & Albert at 5:22 when Hardcore pinned Albert with a dropkick

WWF IC Champion Billy Gunn pinned Eddie Guerrero at 5:41 with the cobra clutch slam after the challenger collided with Dean Malenko on the ring apron; after the bout, the Radicalz attacked the champion

The Rock defeated Rikishi via disqualification at 2:45 when Kurt Angle, who did guest commentary for the match, interfered as Rikishi was locked in the Sharpshooter; after the bout, Rikishi attacked the Rock; the match was to have determined the #1 contender to the world title at Armageddon
The Undertaker defeated Kane via disqualification at 4:12 when Edge, Christian, and Kurt Angle interfered
The Road Dogg & K-Kwick defeated Val Venis & Steven Richards (w/ WWF Women's Champion Ivory) at 4:44 when Kwick pinned Richards

Chris Jericho, Matt & Jeff Hardy (w/ Lita) defeated Chris Benoit, WWF Light Heavyweight Champion Dean Malenko, & Perry Saturn (w/ Terri) at 5:30 when Jerihco applied the Walls of Jericho on Malenko; after the match, the Radicalz attacked their opponents
WWF Hardcore Champion Steve Blackman pinned Tiger Ali Singh at 3:32 after ripping off the challenger's turban and landing a kendo stick blow to the head from the top rope
Steve Austin defeated WWF World Champion Kurt Angle via disqualification at 9:16 when Triple H interfered and helped in double teaming the challenger
Rikishi pinned the Undertaker with a sit-down splash after Taker became distracted by Kurt Angle at ringside; after the bout, Angle further attacked the Undertaker

WWF Tag Team Champions Bull Buchanon & the Goodfather defeated Matt & Jeff Hardy after Buchanon hit the scissors kick on Jeff as the referee was distracted by the Dudley Boyz at ringside; before the bout, the referee sent Ivory backstage but allowed Lita to remain at ringside – where she was watched from afar by Dean Malenko
Chris Benoit defeated Hardcore Holly via submission with the Crippler Crossface
Edge & Christian defeated the Road Dogg & K-Kwick
WWF World Champion Kurt Angle pinned Chris Jericho with the Angle Slam after Kane distracted the challenger; after the bout, Kane laid Jericho out in the ring
WWF IC Champion Billy Gunn (w/ Chyna) defeated Val Venis (w/ Ivory) after Chyna interfered; after the bout, the two members of RTC attacked both Gunn and Chyna
WWF Light Heavyweight Champion Dean Malenko defeated Lita via submission with the Texas Cloverleaf; due to prematch stipulations, Lita would be forced to go out on a date with Malenko on Smackdown!

William Regal defeated WWF European Champion Crash Holly (w/ Molly Holly) at 2:24 to win the title via submission with the Regal Stretch; prior to the match, Regal cut an in-ring promo about his loss of the title two days earlier in England; after the bout, Regal kept the hold applied until Molly came off the top with a crossbody; moments later, Regal dropped Molly with a back suplex and locked her in the Regal Stretch until Hardcore Holly made the save and threw Regal to the floor
Dean Malenko & Perry Saturn (w/ Terri) defeated Matt & Jeff Hardy (w/ Lita) via count-out at 3:35 after Malenko sent Jeff into the ring steps

Billy Gunn defeated WWF IC Champion Chris Benoit via disqualification at 3:26 when Eddie Guerrero prevented the pinfall following the Fameasser; after the match, Guerrero distracted Gunn as Benoit attacked from behind and applied the Crippler Crossface
The Rock & the Dudley Boyz defeated WWF World Champion Kurt Angle & WWF Tag Team Champions Edge & Christian in a tables match at 8:22 after Rock hit the Rock Bottom on Edge through a table
Chyna defeated Ivory via disqualification when Val Venis and Steven Richards interfered; after the match, the RTC hit a spike piledriver on Chyna and she was later stretchered out of the ring
The Acolytes defeated Test & Albert (w/ Trish Stratus) at 2:53 when Bradshaw pinned Albert with a flying shoulderblock and the Clothesline from Hell

Jerry Lawler, the Road Dogg, & K-Kwick defeated Steven Richards, Bull Buchanon, & the Goodfather at the 55-second mark in an impromptu match when Lawler pinned Richards with a fistdrop off the middle turnbuckle
Raven pinned Al Snow in a hardcore match at 3:47 by hitting him with a cinder block after Snow fought off Tiger Ali Singh and Lo-Down outside the arena; after the match, Snow was attended to by EMTs
WWF IC Champion Chris Benoit defeated Jeff Hardy via submission with the Crippler Crossface at 3:38

Val Venis, Bull Buchanon, & the Goodfather (w/ Steven Richards & Ivory) defeated Billy Gunn & the Dudley Boyz at 4:02 when Venis pinned Gunn with a fisherman's suplex after Richards saved Ivory from Gunn
The Rock & the Undertaker defeated WWF Tag Team Champions Edge & Christian to win the titles at 8:42 when the Rock pinned Edge with a spinebuster and the People's Elbow

Chris Jericho defeated Perry Saturn (w/ Terri) via submission with the Walls of Jericho at 2:20; after the match, Saturn, Dean Malenko, and Chris Benoit used their respective finishers on Jericho after Jericho attempted the Walls of Jericho on Terri

WWF European Champion William Regal defeated Steve Austin via disqualification at 4:31 when referee Tim White recovered from a collision and saw Austin with the Euro title belt, which he had taken from Regal, and assumed Austin had used it as a weapon
The Acolytes & Jackie defeated Test, Albert, & Trish Stratus at 1:46 when Jackie pinned Trish with a DDT

WWF World Champion Kurt Angle fought Vince McMahon to a no contest when Mick Foley attacked both; McMahon and Angle beat down Foley before Stephanie McMahon declared that since Linda McMahon was mentally unstable, Vince would immediately take over as CEO; upon hearing that, Vince fired Foley
WWF Hardcore Champion Steve Blackman defeated Raven and Hardcore Holly at 3:42 after hitting a German suplex on Holly onto the hood of a car
Raven pinned WWF Hardcore Champion Steve Blackman to win the title after hitting him with a 2X4
Steve Austin defeated Kane via disqualification at 7:22 when William Regal attacked Austin; after the match, Austin fought off both men
Scotty 2 Hotty & Grandmaster Sexay defeated Test & Albert at 3:39 when Grandmaster Sexay pinned Test with a school boy roll up after Stephanie McMahon tripped Test

WWF World Champion Kurt Angle & WWF Tag Team Champions Edge & Christian defeated Chris Jericho & the Dudley Boyz at 5:07 when Angle pinned Jericho with the Olympic Slam after avoiding the Lionsault; after the match, the Dudley Boyz made the save for Jericho against Angle and several of his family members
The Goodfather & Bull Buchanon (w/ Steven Richards & Ivory) defeated the Acolytes (w/ Jackie) at 2:32 following the scissors kick from Buchanon after Val Venis interfered
The Rock defeated the Undertaker via disqualification at 9:34 when Rikishi interfered and attacked both men
The Blue Blazer pinned Val Venis at 2:19
The Big Show pinned Test in 47 seconds
D-Lo Brown defeated Droz via disqualification at 3:16
WWF Tag Team Champions Kane & X-Pac defeated the Road Dogg & Billy Gunn at 7:00 when X-Pac pinned Gunn
Ken Shamrock defeated Bradshaw via KO in a streetfight at 4:05
Mankind defeated the Big Bossman at 1:35 with the Mandible Claw
WWF World Champion Steve Austin & the Rock fought the Undertaker & Triple H to a no contest at 5:00

Billy Gunn pinned WWF IC Champion Jeff Jarrett (w/ Miss Kitty & Debra) in a non-title match at 2:54 with a roll up and grabbing the tights for leverage after Chyna came ringside and accidentally broke Jarrett's guitar over Debra when she attempted to hit Miss Kitty; after the bout, Gunn attempted to moon Chyna but she hit a low blow on him from behind before he could

WWF Tag Team Champions the Undertaker & the Big Show (w/ Paul Bearer) defeated X-Pac & Kane and the Acolytes at 3:47 when Show pinned X-Pac with the chokeslam; the Undertaker did guest commentary for the bout and made Show defend the titles by himself in a showing of tough love

The Big Bossman pinned WWF Hardcore Champion Al Snow to win the title at 2:20 after hitting Snow in the head with the nightstick as Snow went for Pepper the dog, who was on the commentary table; prior to the bout, Bossman came out and told Snow that he would give Pepper back if Snow gave him a title shot however, after the bout, Bossman took Pepper with him while Snow was still knocked out

The Road Dogg defeated Chris Jericho via disqualification at 4:31 after Jericho powerbombed his opponent through a table set up in the ring; after the bout, Jericho applied the Walls of Jericho until a number of officials made him break it, then briefly reapplied the hold before leaving the ring (Jericho's TV wrestling debut)

Shane McMahon pinned Mankind at around the 3:30 mark after Triple H came ringside and hit Mankind in the leg with a steel chair, while the Mandible Claw was applied, as Chyna distracted the referee; prior to the bout, Stephanie McMahon came to the ring and asked Test to come out so she could give him an answer to his marriage proposal; after Test came to the ring, he got down on one knee and asked a second time, with Stephanie saying yes; moments later, Shane McMahon & the Mean Street Posse attacked Test until Mankind made the save with a steel chair; Mankind then grabbed the microphone, told Shane to leave Test and Stephanie alone, and then said that his match with Shane would begin right then and there; to get Shane to agree to the match, Mankind offered Shane one free shot with the steel chair; during the bout, Pat Patterson, Gerald Brisco, Test, and Stephanie McMahon battled with the Mean Street Posse into the crowd

Tori defeated WWF Women's Champion Ivory in a non-title Evening Gown match at the 58-second mark; prior to the bout, Tori attempted to come out in nothing but a thong but a number of officials and referees wouldn't allow her to; she eventually came out wearing Tony Garea's shirt after he took it off for her to put on; after the bout, Tori further attacked Ivory until Luna came out to restrain her, as Ivory ran backstage

WWF World Champion Triple H pinned the Rock at 9:43 with the Pedigree after guest referee Shawn Michaels hit the superkick on the challenger as he attempted the People's Elbow; early in the bout, Michaels ejected Chyna from ringside for hitting a low blow on Rock while on the floor; Shane McMahon came out moments later; after the bout, Triple H, Michaels, Shane, and Chyna embraced in the ring

Chyna pinned Billy Gunn at 2:27 after WWF World Champion Triple H interfered, as the referee was knocked on the floor, and dropped Gunn with the Pedigree; following the ring entrances, WWF IC Champion Jeff Jarrett, Debra, & Miss Kitty came out, with Jarrett providing guest commentary; Chyna's IC title match at Unforgiven was at stake in the contest

Tony Chimel defeated Howard Finkel in an impromptu tuxedo match at 1:52; prior to the bout, Finkel walked out, took the mic, and said Chimel humilated him the previous week; Finkel went on to challenge Chimel to a tuxedo match and said he would regain his ring announcing duties if he won; Chimel told Finkel to go backstage, with Finkel agreeing until he jumped Chimel from behind to start the contest; Chris Jericho was shown watching on backstage during the match; following the commercial break, footage was shown of Jericho speaking to Finkel backstage and telling him he could be a Jockey model

X-Pac defeated Chris Jericho via disqualification at 3:39 when Big Show, who watched much of the match from the entrance stage, attacked X-Pac in the ring; prior to the bout, footage was shown of Jericho injuring Road Dogg the previous week before attacking Ken Shamrock with a steel chair; following the entrances, Shamrock came out and scared Jericho to the floor, before X-Pac asked him to let him have the match and Shamrock returned backstage; after Shamrock went backstage, the Undertaker and Show walked out to the entrance stage; immediately after the match, Shamrock ran out and chased Jericho through the crowd; Show then sat up X-Pac for the chokeslam until Kane made the save and knocked Show to the floor; Taker, on the mic, then ordered Show to leave them before telling Kane he was pathetic and X-Pac was making him weak and vulnerable; following the commercial break, Shamrock was shown destroying the backstage area while looking for Jericho

WWF World Champion Triple H (w/ Chyna) pinned WWF Light Heavyweight Champion Gillberg at 1:53 with the Pedigree; following Triple H and Chyna's entrance, Shane McMahon joined them in the ring, praised Triple H, and called for his “bald headed SOB” opponent to come out; Tony Garea then knocked on Gillberg's dressing room backstage; Triple H and Shane embraced during Gillberg's entrance; Shane provided guest commentary for the bout; after the contest, Triple H grabbed a chair, knocked the referee down, and assaulted Gillberg's leg with the chair

WWF Tag Team Champion the Rock fought WWF Tag Team Champion Mankind to a double disqualification at at 3:29 when WWF World Champion Triple H and Chyna attacked both men; during the bout, both men took turns stealing and putting on a headset from the announce team; Shane McMahon took over as guest referee at the 3-minute mark after the initial referee was knocked out; the bout was to determine Triple H's #1 contender challenger at Unforgiven; after the contest, Shane took the mic and announce neither man won

Ken Shamrock defeated Val Venis via submission to the ankle lock at 1:45; after the match, Shamrock kept the hold applied before Steve Blackman ran out and Shamrock laid out Blackman with his own nunchucks; moments later, Chris Jericho walked out to the entrance stage and mocked Shamrock, daring him to follow Jericho to the parking lot; Shamrock then ran backstage after Jericho before Blackman assaulted Venis with his nunchucks; Shamrock was then shown confronting “Jericho” backstage, only for it to be revealed as Howard Finkel in costume; Jericho assaulted Shamrock from behind with a shovel, applied the Walls of Jericho, and had Finkel take a Polaroid; Jericho went on to say, “Oh my god, I killed Kenny” before driving out of the parking lot, with Finkel in the trunk of his car

Hardcore & Crash Holly, Viscera & Mideon, the Acolytes, Matt & Jeff Hardy, Edge & Christian, Albert & Droz, and Stevie Richards & the Blue Meanie fought to a no contest in a gauntlet match at 7:07; Crash pinned Mideon at 1:38 after Viscera accidentally splashed his parnter in the corner; Hardcore pinned Droz at 2:59 with a suplex into a powerslam; Matt pinned Crash with a moonasult off the top to a standing Crash at 3:21; Bradshaw pinned Jeff at 4:25 with the Clothesline from Hell as Jeff attempted a springboard into the corner; Bradshaw pinned Richards with a powerbomb at 6:01; the Blue Meanie never made it in the ring for the fall; the Dudley Boyz attacked both Edge & Christian and the Acolytes with 2x4s to end the match (the Dudleyz's Smackdown debut)

WWF Tag Team Champions the Rock & Mankind defeated WWF World Champion Triple H & Shane McMahon (w/ Chyna) at 6:56 when the Rock pinned Triple H with the Rock Bottom and People's Elbow after Billy Gunn interfered and hit the Fameasser on the world champion; Mankind wrestled the opening moments of the match himself before the Rock made his entrance

notes: Smith's return match after a 2 year absence
matches.line: Davey Boy Smith pinned WWF Hardcore Champion the Big Bossman to win the title after hitting the champion with Bossman's own nightstick (Smith's return match after a 2 year absence); after the match, Smith gave the title to Al Snow

Edge & Christian (w/ Steven Richards) defeated Matt & Jeff Hardy (w/ Gangrel) when Edge scored the pin with a sidewalk slam; Kane destroyed the Hardyz & Gangrel after the match and cut a promo on Triple H
Hardcore Holly (w/ Crash Holly) fought Chyna to a no contest after Jeff Jarrett, Billy Gunn, and Crash interfered
Bradshaw (w/ Farooq) defeated Bubba Ray Dudley (w/ D-Von Dudley) via disqualification when D-Von interfered; the two teams had to be held apart after the match
WWF World Champion Triple H (w/ Chyna) pinned Kane with the Pedigree after Chyna hit Kane with the slegdehammer
Chris Jericho fought Ken Shamrock to a no contest when the two brawled on the ramp before the actual match began

The Undertaker & the Big Show defeated WWF Tag Team Champions Mankind & the Rock to win the titles in a Buried Alive match at 11:43 after WWF World Champion Triple H came out, as Rock and Taker fought near the entrance stage, struck Show in the back of the head with a sledgehammer and then poured dirt onto Mankind in the grave; mid-way through the match, Rock and Taker fought their way backstage, where Triple H attacked Rock before Kane intervened; moments later, Chyna hit Kane in the back with a steel chair but he shrugged it off and stalked her down the hallway; after the match, an ambulance drove into the arena to tend to Mankind and Show; moments later, Triple H opened the ambulance door to find Steve Austin inside; Austin then attacked Triple H, put him in the ambulance, and drove it out of the arena; Austin then got into a WWE tractor trailer and twice drove it into the ambulance
Shane McMahon pinned Joey Abs (w/ Rodney, Pete Gas, & Terri Runnels) when Shawn Stasiak took over as the official after the referee, Gerald Brisco, had been knocked out
WWF European Champion Mark Henry pinned Steve Blackman after Val Venis interfered and hit Blackman with his own kendo stick
Curtis Hughes (w/ Chris Jericho) defeated Ken Shamrock via disqualification when the special referee, El Dopo (Howard Finkel under a mask), stopped the match
The Undertaker won a 5-man Royal Rumble match by last eliminating both the Rock and the Big Show; other participants included Kane and Mankind
Billy Gunn & Chyna defeated Hardcore & Crash Holly when Gunn pinned Crash with the Fameasser; after the match, Jeff Jarrett knocked Chyna out with a frying pan and put an apron on her
Al Snow defeated the Big Bossman in a Pepper on a Pole match, with the remains of Snow's dog at stake
WWF IC Champion Jeff Jarrett (w/ Miss Kitty & Debra) fought Test to a no contest when the Mean Street Posse, Gerald Brisco, Pat Patterson, Shawn Stasiak, and Shane & Stephanie McMahon interfered

Vince McMahon pinned WWF World Champion Triple H to win the title in an impromptu match at 8:53 after Steve Austin interfered, hit the Stunner on Chyna, and the champion, and laid McMahon on top for the win; prior to the decision, there was interference from Linda McMahon, Chyna, Gerald Brisco, and Pat Patterson; Shane McMahon was the guest referee for the bout
The Big Show defeated Triple H in a Chokeslam match; Triple H 0-1
X-Pac defeated WWF European Champion Mark Henry via count-out when Henry and D-Lo Brown began brawling at ringside
Triple H defeated Kane in an Inferno match after Mideon and Viscera attacked Kane at ringside after brutally attacking X-Pac backstage; Triple H 1-1
The Road Dogg & Billy Gunn defeated WWF Tag Team Champions the Rock & Mankind to win the titles after Gunn hit the Fameasser on Mankind
Mideon & Viscera (sub. for the Undertaker) defeated Triple H in a Casket match; Triple H 1-2
Hardcore Holly (w/ Crash Holly) pinned Al Snow with the Hollycaust after the Big Bossman distracted Snow from ringside
Triple H defeated Mankind in a Boiler Room Brawl; Triple H 2-2
Chris Jericho (w/ Curtis Hughes) defeated Ken Shamrock in a First Blood Match after hitting him with a hockey stick and causing Shamrock to cough up blood (Shamrock's last appearance)

Triple H pinned the Rock in a Brahma Bull Strap Match following the Pedigree after guest referee, Davey Boy Smith, hit the running powerslam on the Rock; Triple H 3-2, therefore earning a spot in the 6-Pack Challenge at Unforgiven
The Road Dogg (w/ Billy Gunn) fought Chris Jericho to a no contest when Curtis Hughes and the Hollys interfered
Edge & Christian defeated Matt & Jeff Hardy (w/ Gangrel) following a double superplex on one of the Hardyz; 1st match in the TIT series
The Big Show fought WWF European Champion D-Lo Brown to a no contest in a non-title match when Droz and Prince Albert interfered; Mark Henry made the save for D-Lo after the match
X-Pac & Kane defeated the Dudley Boyz and the Acolytes in an elimination match when Kane pinned D-Von Dudley with the chokeslam; the Acolytes were eliminated earlier after Farooq pushed the referee

Davey Boy Smith fought WWF World Champion Triple H to a no contest when guest referee, the Rock, refused to make the pinfall on either man and ended up giving both participants the People's Elbow; after the match, Smith attacked the Rock while Steve Austin attacked the champion
X-Pac & Kane defeated Viscera & Mideon at 2:41 when Kane pinned Mideon with the chokeslam; the Acolytes came through the crowd and attacked X-Pac & Kane after the match
Hardcore Holly (w/ Crash Holly) pinned the Road Dogg (w/ Billy Gunn) at 5:14; Gunn & Road Dogg fought off the Hollys after the match
Matt & Jeff Hardy defeated Edge & Christian at 6:12 in a Texas Tornado match following the Swanton Bomb by Jeff; this was the 3rd bout in the TIT Best of 7 series
WWF Women's Champion Ivory defeated Miss Kitty in a mud wrestling match; after the match, Chyna tossed Jeff Jarrett into the mud, where he was attacked by Mae Young and the Fabulous Moolah
Mankind fought Davey Boy Smith to a no contest at around the 6:15 mark when the two brawled into the crowd

The Big Show defeated the Big Bossman via disqualification at 2:25 when Bossman used his nightstick as a weapon to avoid the chokeslam; after the match, Show hit the chokeslam on Bossman; the bout was originally taped for Sunday Night Heat but was shown on Smackdown!, replacing the scheduled Droz / D-Lo match

The Rock pinned Val Venis in a No DQ match with the Rock Bottom at 10:14, moments after hitting the same move on an interfering Mankind; during the bout, the Rock stopped by the commentary table and briefly put on a headset; late in the match, Mankind came out to stop Venis from using a steel chair, but then accidentally hit Rock with the weapon moments later
The Acolytes defeated Kane in a handicap match; X-Pac made the save with a chair after the bout
Chris Jericho pinned Curtis Hughes after hitting him with a chair
The Big Bossman defeated WWF Hardcore Champion Al Snow and the Big Show to win the title by pinning Snow following a chokeslam by Show; Bossman attacked Show with a nightstick and gained the pinfall
Val Venis pinned Stevie Richards (dressed as Dude Love) with the Money Shot
Matt & Jeff Hardy (w/ Gangrel) defeated Edge & Christian in Match #5 of the TIT when Jeff pinned Edge; Christian had Matt pinned as well but they were the illegal men in the ring
The Godfather pinned Mideion (w/ Viscera) with the Pimp Drop; Viscera attacked Godfather after the match

Mankind & the Rock defeated WWF Tag Team Champions the Road Dogg & Billy Gunn to win the titles when Mankind pinned Gunn after Hardcore Holly interfered behind the referee's back and hit Gunn with the title belt following the Fameasser on Mankind

Test, Edge & Christian defeated Davey Boy Smith, Joey Abs, Rodney, & Pete Gas in a handicap match at 2:43 when Test pinned Rodney with the flying elbow drop immediately after Rodney sustained a double decker superplex from Edge & Christian; the bout was originally a one-on-one bout between Test and Smith but turned into a tag team match when Smith came out with the Mean Street Posse
WWF World Champion Triple H pinned Al Snow at 4:22 with a kick to the midsection and the Pedigree after avoiding the Snow Plow

Mankind fought the Rock to a no contest at 6:00 when Val Venis, who was doing guest commentary, attacked Mankind on the floor and in the ring with his own book; moments later, the Rock hit the Rock Bottom on Venis and attempted to do the same to Mankind but Triple H came out, jumped Rock from behind, and hit the Pedigree; had Mankind defeated the Rock, he would have won Rock's #1 contender spot

WWF Women's Champion the Fabulous Moolah fought Mae Young to a no contest at 2:57 when Ivory attacked both women; moments later, Tori, Jackie, and Luna came out and all of the women began fighting each other until referees swarmed the ring and Ivory was chased to the back

WWF Tag Team Champions Hardcore & Crash Holly defeated Matt & Jeff Hardy (w/ Terri) at 3:54 when Hardcore pinned Jeff with a dropkick as Jeff attempted a leap from Matt's back onto Holly in the corner; after the bout, the Road Dogg & Billy Gunn jumped the Hollys on the ramp until the champions ran backstage

The Big Show fought the Big Bossman to a no contest when, as Show came out and hit three chokeslams on the fake police officer who told him his father had died Monday, Bossman escaped through the crowd before the match began

The Godfather & Mark Henry defeated Viscera & Mideon at 1:30 when Henry pinned Mideon with a splash after Godfather hit the Ho Train; the bout was originally Viscera vs. Godfather but was turned into a tag team match when Mark Henry came out after everyone made their entrances

Steve Austin pinned Val Venis at 9:57 with a kick to the midsection and the Stunner after avoiding a clothesline; after the bout, Triple H attacked Austin from behind, with the Rock coming out and attacking Triple H as the show came to a close

Grandmaster Sexay & Scotty 2 Hotty defeated Edge & Christian after Crash Holly, who did guest commentary for the bout along with Hardcore Holly, hit Edge with his scale; after the bout, the Hollys and Grandmaster Sexay & Scotty 2 Hotty further attacked Edge & Christian
Stevie Richards (dressed as Chyna) pinned Chris Jericho after Chyna interfered and hit Jericho with the IC title; after the bout, both Jericho and Chyna attacked Richards
Davey Boy Smith (w/ the Mean Street Posse) pinned WWF European Champion D-Lo Brown to win the title with the running powerslam after Pete Gas prevented the champion from hitting the frog splash
The Dudley Boyz defeated Kane & X-Pac when X-Pac turned on his partner, hit a low blow, and all of DX attacked Kane
Matt & Jeff Hardy (w/ Terri) defeated Viscera & Mark Henry after Terri distracted Mark; after the match, Viscera attacked Henry
Al Snow defeated WWF Hardcore Champion the Big Bossman (w/ Albert) via disqualification in a non-title match after Bossman hit Snow with the title belt
Mankind defeated Val Venis via submission with the Mandible Claw
Mankind & Al Snow defeated WWF Tag Team Champions Hardcore & Crash Holly to win the titles following Mankind's double arm DDT
D-Lo Brown pinned Test with an inside cradle
Matt & Jeff Hardy defeated Grandmaster Sexay & Scotty 2 Hotty following Jeff's Swanton
Edge defeated WWF European Champion Davey Boy Smith (w/ the Mean Street Posse) via disqualification when Joey Abs interfered; after the match, the Posse brawled with the Headbangers
The Godfather pinned Chris Jericho with the Ho Train after Stevie Richards came out dressed as ho and superkicked Jericho
The Big Show fought the Big Bossman to a double count-out; after the match, Show hit the chokeslam on Bossman, then a host of officials that attempted to stop him

WWF World Champion Triple H, the Road Dogg, Billy Gunn, & X-Pac defeated Steve Austin, the Rock, Kane, & Shane McMahon in an elimination match at around the 14-minute mark; X-Pac pinned Kane at 2:54 with the X-Factor after Gunn hit the Fameasser; X-Pac pinned McMahon with the Fameasser at around the 6-minute mark; Rock pinned Road Dogg with the Rock Bottom at around the 8-minute mark; Austin pinned X-Pac with the Stunner at around the 10:30 mark; Rock pinned Gunn with a roll over at around the 12-minute mark; Triple H pinned Rock with the Pedigree at around the 12:30 mark; Triple H pinned Austin after Vince McMahon, who came ringside early in the match, accidentally hit Austin in the face with the title belt behind the referee's back; moments earlier, McMahon went to give Austin a steel chair but Triple H pulled it away for himself

Hardcore Holly (w/ Crash Holly) pinned Edge (w/ Christian) at 3:22 with an inside cradle immediately after Edge hit a superplex; prior to the bout, it was noted Edge, Christian, Matt & Jeff Hardy would face Grandmaster Sexay, Scotty 2 Hotty, Hardcore & Crash in an elimination match at Survivor Series

The Dudley Boyz defeated the Godfather & D-Lo Brown at 3:59 when D-Von pinned D-Lo with the 3D behind the referee's back; prior to the bout, it was announced Godfather, D-Lo, & the Headbangers would face the Dudleyz, Farooq & Bradshaw in an elimination match at Survivor Series

Val Venis fought WWF European Champion Davey Boy Smith (w/ Pete Gas, Rodney, & Pete Gas) to a no contest at 1:16 when the Mean Street Posse attacked Venis in the ring, prompting Steve Blackman, Gangrel, and Mark Henry to run out and brawl with the Posse and Smith; prior to the bout, it was noted Venis, Henry, Gangrel, & Blackman would face Smith & the Mean Street Posse in an elimination match at Survivor Series; following his entrance, Venis took the mic and mocked the fact Al Snow's action figure was removed from Walmart; Venis then joked that it's said Snow treats women like objects but that was actually his gimmick; it was noted during the match that Mankind & Al Snow would challenge WWF Tag Team Champions Billy Gunn & the Road Dogg at Survivor Series

WWF Hardcore Champion the Big Bossman pinned Farooq at 2:37 on the floor after Albert sprayed the challenger with mace and Bossman followed by striking Farooq in the head with the ringsteps; prior to the match, Bossman took the mic, apologized for being late because he had to go to a funeral; Bossman then said it didn't matter what partners Show found for Survivor Series because his chances of beating Bossman “were as stiff as your dad;” Farooq then walked out and said he was the one who was mean, nasty, and cruel; immediately after the bout, Bradshaw ran out and struck Albert with a steel chair, scaring Bossman backstage

Grandmaster Sexay (w/ Scotty 2 Hotty) pinned Jeff Hardy (w/ Matt Hardy & Terri Runnels) at 3:32 with a reverse Russian legsweep after sending an interfering Matt into Jeff behind the referee's back; earlier in the match, Scotty interfered behind the referee's back

Tori fought WWF Women's Champion Ivory to a no contest at 1:17 when Debra, Jackie, Luna, Terri Runnels, Mae Young, and the Fabulous Moolah interfered; prior to the bout, it was announced Moolah, Mae, Tori, & Debra would face Ivory, Jackie, Luna Vachon, & Terri at Survivor Series; following her entrance, Ivory took the mic and called out Tori, then mocking her “big red retard boyfriend,” with Tori then running out and tackling her to start the match; moments later, all the other women walked out and surrounded the ring; after the contest, referees had to hold the participants apart

winners: the Road Dogg in an elimination match; prior to the bout
Test was shown being tended to by a doctor backstage
who noted the nose was broken; following his entrance
it was noted Kane would face X-Pac at Survivor Series; Steve Austin was the guest enforcer for the match
while Arnold Schwarzenegger provided guest commentary; order of elimination: Kane
matches.line: The Rock, Shane McMahon, Kane, & Test defeated WWF World Champion Triple H, X-Pac, WWF Tag Team Champions Billy Gunn & the Road Dogg in an elimination match; prior to the bout, Test was shown being tended to by a doctor backstage, who noted the nose was broken; following his entrance, it was noted Kane would face X-Pac at Survivor Series; Steve Austin was the guest enforcer for the match, while Arnold Schwarzenegger provided guest commentary; order of elimination: Kane fought X-Pac to a double count-out at around the 45-second mark when both men fought their way backstage; Road Dogg pinned Shane at 5:55 after Gunn hit the Fameasser behind the referee's back; Test, who did not come out at the start of the match because of his injury, joined the match at the 6-minute mark; Gunn was disqualified at 7:00 for hitting Test with a chair from the floor as Test ran the ropes; Rock pinned Road Dogg with the Rock Bottom at 8:33; Test pinned Triple H at 10:09 after Austin hit Triple H with a chair handed to him by Schwarzenegger aand counted the pinfall; moments earlier, Triple H threw referee Earl Hebner to the floor, with Austin trying to hit Triple H with a chair but accidentally striking Rock; after the match, Triple H tried to assault Arnold at the commentary table but Arnold ducked him and landed a series of punches himself; Austin then laid out Triple H, with he and Arnold then sharing beers in the ring as the show ended
Grandmaster Sexay & Scotty 2 Hotty defeated Edge & Christian at 4:14 when Scotty 2 Hotty pinned Christian after Grandmaster Sexay hit the top rope legdrop behind the referee's back
Kurt Angle pinned Gangrel at 2:34 with the Olympic Slam
WWF European Champion Davey Boy Smith pinned the Godfather at 2:06 with the running powerslam moments after the Mean Street Posse attacked the challenger on the floor
WWF World Champion the Big Show pinned Hardcore Holly (w/ Crash Holly) with the chokeslam at 1:30; the Big Bossman attacked the champion after the match
Kane (w/ Tori) pinned Viscera with a chokeslam at 2:02
WWF Women's Champion Ivory defeated Jackie and Luna in a hardcore match by pinning Jackie at 4:35 after hitting her with a cookie sheet
Chris Jericho pinned Mark Henry with a bulldog and the Lionsault at the 44-second mark
WWF Tag Team Champions Billy Gunn & the Road Dogg defeated Matt & Jeff Hardy at 4:49 after X-Pac interfered and hit the X-Factor on Matt

The Rock pinned the Big Bossman (w/ Albert) with the Rock Bottom at 3:06; the Big Show made the save for the Rock after the match; Hardcore & Crash Holly tried to attack the Rock but were met with Rock Bottoms
WWF World Champion the Big Show pinned Chris Jericho with the chokeslam after Chyna interfered and twice hit the challenger with a hammer
Kurt Angle pinned D-Lo Brown with the Olympic Slam
Val Venis defeated WWF European Champion Davey Boy Smith via disqualification after the champion hit a low blow
WWF Hardcore Champion the Big Bossman pinned Kane (w/ Tori) after Viscera and Prince Albert interfered backstage
The Rock & Mankind defeated Hardcore & Crash Holly when Rock pinned Crash with the People's Elbow; due to prematch stipulations, Rock & Mankind became the #1 contenders to the tag team titles
Rikishi (w/ Grandmaster Sexay & Scotty 2 Hotty) pinned Joey Abs (w/ the Mean Street Posse) following the Rikishi Driver
Jackie pinned Ivory in a Gravy Bowl match following a DDT; Miss Kitty was the referee
The Godfather pinned Al Snow with the Ho Train and a roll up

WWF Tag Team Champions the Road Dogg & Billy Gunn defeated Matt & Jeff Hardy in a steel cage match when Gunn escaped the cage; Jeff Hardy originally escaped to the floor first after being backdropped by Gunn but X-Pac put him back in the ring before the referee could notice

Triple H & X-Pac defeated Test & Shane McMahon after the New Age Outlaws interfered and X-Pac hit Test with the X-Factor; after the match, Vince McMahon sent numerous WWF superstars to make the save since he was held back due to a restraining order by DX
Viscera defeated Kane via count-out when Kane chased X-Pac from ringside; after the bout, Kane hit the chokeslam on Viscera

The Dudley Boyz defeated Edge & Christian when D-Von pinned Edge after Edge suffered a knee injury while attempting a hurricanrana on Bubba Ray; after the bout, the Acolytes made the save against the Dudleyz
WWF European Champion Davey Boy Smith defeated D-Lo Brown via disqualification when Val Venis interfered and attacked the champion; after the bout, all three men continued to brawl
Chris Jericho pinned Mankind with a roll up after Mankind accidentally knocked Miss Kitty off the ring apron; Kitty had come ringside with Chyna earlier in the match
Kurt Angle & Steve Blackman defeated the Headbangers when Angle pinned Thrasher with a belly to belly suplex
Rikishi (w/ Grandmaster Sexay & Scotty 2 Hotty) pinned Crash Holly with the Rikishi Driver; Hardcore Holly was the guest commentator for the match
The Rock pinned Al Snow with the People's Elbow; after the bout, Mankind made the save against Snow, the Road Dogg, and Billy Gunn

WWF World Champion the Big Show, Matt, & Jeff Hardy (w/ Terri Runnels) defeated X-Pac & WWF Tag Team Champions the Road Dogg & Billy Gunn when Matt pinned X-Pac with a sunset flip; after the bout, the Rock, Kane, and Mankind made the save against the Big Bossman and DX
WWF Tag Team Champion the Road Dogg pinned Chris Jericho with a pumphandle slam after Chyna pushed Jericho's foot off the rope during the cover
The Dudley Boyz defeated Kurt Angle & Steve Blackman when Bubba Ray pinned Blackman following the 3D after Blackman and Angle collided, knocking Angle to the floor
Christian defeated WWF European Champion Davey Boy Smith via disqualification when the Mean Street Posse interfered; D-Lo Brown and Val Venis made the save after the match
The Big Bossman & Prince Albert defeated Matt & Jeff Hardy via disqualification when the Big Show interfered and chased both Bossman and Albert out of the arena, where they escaped in a van
Mankind defeated Al Snow via disqualification after Snow hit a low blow and used a chair
X-Pac pinned Test with a low blow and the X-Factor
The Rock pinned WWF Tag Team Champion Billy Gunn with the People's Elbow

Kane fought Triple H to a no contest after Triple H attacked referee Earl Hebner, a number of other officials wearing Vince McMahon masks took over as referee, and Triple H attempted to leave ringside – only to be met by a masked man with a sledgehammer
WWF IC Champion Chris Jericho pinned Albert (w/ the Big Bossman) after Chyna countered Bossman's interference, Jericho hit Albert with the Bossman's nightstick, and scored the win with the Lionsault

Kurt Angle defeated Test via disqualification when Stephanie McMahon ordered the time keeper to ring the bell as Test was punching Angle in the corner; after the match, Stephanie lured Test to the ramp where he was attacked by DX
Matt Hardy pinned Jeff Hardy with a sleeper slam
X-Pac (sub. for Stephanie McMahon) pinned Tori with the X-Factor while the Mean Street Posse attacked Kane backstage
Mankind pinned Al Snow in a falls count anywhere match after the Rock hit Snow with a chair backstage
Edge pinned Christian with a roll over
The Acolytes defeated the Mean Street Posse when Farooq pinned Rodney with a spinebuster
Rikishi, Grandmaster Sexay & Scotty 2 Hotty defeated Viscera, Hardcore & Crash Holly when Rikishi pinned Hardcore with the Bonzai Drop
WWF Tag Team Champions the Road Dogg & Billy Gunn defeated Gerald Brisco & Pat Patterson following Gunn's Fameasser on Brisco

The Rock fought WWF World Champion the Big Show to a no contest in a lumberjack match when all the lumberjacks attacked the competitors until Mankind made the save and all three men fended off the lumberjacks with weapons; lumberjacks included: X-Pac, Billy Gunn, the Road Dogg, the Mean Street Posse, Viscera, Prince Albert, Mideon, Al Snow, Hardcore Holly, Crash Holly, Kurt Angle, and Gangrel
WWF IC Champion Chris Jericho defeated Hardcore Holly (w/ Crash Holly) via disqualification when Crash interfered; after the bout, Chyna made the save
Rikishi pinned Viscera with the Bonzai Drop
Test pinned WWF Tag Team Champion the Road Dogg with the pumphandle slam and a flying elbowsmash
Kurt Angle pinned Edge with the Angle Slam after Steve Blackman interfered and hit Edge with a kendo stick
The Rock pinned Al Snow in a steel cage match with a spinebuster onto a chair and the People's Elbow; prematch stipulations stated that had Snow won he would have recieved a world title match on Raw
WWF Women's Champion the Kat (w/ Chyna) pinned Ivory in a No DQ math after Chyna hit the Pedigree on the challenger

Christian & Jeff Hardy (w/ Terri Runnels) defeated Taka Michinoku & Sho Funaki (w/ the Mean Street Posse) when Jeff pinned Funaki with the Senton; after the bout, Kaientai attacked the Posse from behind and ran off

Kane pinned WWF Tag Team Champion Billy Gunn with the chokeslam; after the bout, Kane continued to pound on Gunn all the way backstage where he forced the Road Dogg to tell him that Tori was at the airport
Mark Henry (w/ the Fabulous Moolah & Mae Young) pinned Bubba Ray Dudley (w/ D-Von Dudley) with a splash

Mankind fought WWF World Champion the Big Show to a no contest when Triple H and the New Age Outlaws attacked Mankind and then both men; for the duration of the match, Triple H was locked in a cage high above the ring but later escaped
WWF Hardcore Champion the Big Bossman & Albert defeated Test in a handicap match when Albert hit the scissors kick moments after Bossman hit Test with his nightstick

Kurt Angle pinned Rikishi (w/ Grandmaster Sexay & Scotty 2 Hotty) after Steve Blackman, who was handcuffed to a ringpost for the match, unlocked the cuffs, and hit Rikishi with a pair of nunchucks before locking himself back to the ringpost
Jeff Hardy pinned Al Snow after Matt Hardy interfered and hit Snow with a chair
Crash & Hardcore Holly defeated the Fabulous Moolah & Mae Young (w/ Harvey Wippleman & Mark Henry) when Crash pinned Mae with a powerslam

The Rock pinned Kane (w/ Tori) in a no holds barred match at 5:13 with a Rock Bottom onto a steel chair after Kane accidentally hit an interfering Tori with a clothesline and was then hit in the head with the chair by Rock

Chyna (w/ WWF Women's Champion Miss Kitty) fought WWF IC Champion Chris Jericho to a draw at 3:50 when two referees each claimed the other wrestler won following a back suplex by Jericho which saw all four shoulders down for the pinfall; prior to the bout, Chyna claimed the reason she had been saving Jericho from losing the title was because she was recovering from an injury and wanted to take the title from him herself; during Jericho's entrance, he claimed the reason she had been coming ringside during his matches was because she had a crush on him; after the match, several referees came out to break up the fight between Jericho and Chyna, with Stephanie McMahon later ruling both Jericho and Chyna were co-holders of the belt
Farooq (w/ Bradshaw) defeated Bubba Ray Dudley (w/ D-Von Dudley) via disqualification when the Mean Street Posse interfered and attacked Farooq as the Dudleyz attacked Bradshaw
Viscera & Jackie defeated Gangrel & Luna when Viscera pinned Luna with a splash; after the bout, Luna had to be taken from ringside on a stretcher

Triple H, X-Pac, & WWF Tag Team Champions the Road Dogg & Billy Gunn defeated WWF World Champion the Big Show in a handicap match when X-Pac made the pin following a chair shot, the Fameasser onto a chair, the Bronco Buster, and the Pedigree; the match was originally scheduled for X-Pac vs. the Big Show but Triple H changed the stipulations throughout the match, adding a 2-on-1 advantage, then 3-on-1, and finally 4-on-1

X-Pac defeated the Big Show via disqualification at 1:09 after Show shoved referee Mike Chioda out of the way while assaulting X-Pac in the corner; after the bout, Show dropped Chioda with the chokeslam, no-sold X-Pac hitting him with a steel chair, and manhandled him before referees swarmed the ring; Show then shoved Chioda to the floor

Hardcore & Crash Holly defeated WWF IC Champion Chris Jericho & WWF IC Champion Chyna (w/ WWF Women's Champion the Kat) at 4:25 when Hardcore pinned Jericho with a suplex into a powerslam, moments after Chyna dropped Jericho with a clothesline on the floor and rolled him back into the ring

The Acolytes defeated WWF Tag Team Champion Billy Gunn via disqualification in a handicap match at 2:04 after WWF Tag Team Champion the Road Dogg interfered; after the match, the Acolytes assaulted the New Age Outlaws and fought with them into the crowd; moments later, Kane was shown in Triple H and Stephanie McMahon's office demanding a match with Road Dogg; following the commercial break, Triple H and Stephanie informed Road Dogg of his match against Kane, with Triple H saying he would have to let Gunn go if he interfered in the match

Kane (w/ Tori) pinned WWF Tag Team Champion the Road Dogg at 5:07 with the chokeslam and tombstone; stipulations stated WWF Tag Team Champion Billy Gunn would be fired if he interfered in the match; Kane attacked Road Dogg in the aisle and around ringside for a few minutes before the bout officially began; X-Pac briefly appeared late in the match, distracting Kane from the aisle

Kurt Angle defeated the Rock via disqualification at 3:44 when Rock fought off interference from Steve Blackman and hit both Blackman and Angle with Blackman's kendo stick; prior to the bout, the Rock cut a promo on his win over DX during Raw; moments later, Angle cut his own promo noting his undefeated streak and said he should be the true people's champion; Rock went on to tell Angle to shove his medals up his ass; after the contest, Rock dropped Angle with the Rock Bottom; after Rock left the ring, Angle celebrated his victory until the Rock returned, hit the spinebuster, and landed the People's Elbow; moments later, Triple H was shown backstage, upset that Angle remained undefeated

Edge, Christian, & Jeff Hardy (w/ Terri Runnels & Matt Hardy) defeated Al Snow & the Dudley Boyz when Edge pinned D-Von Dudley with the Downard Spiral at 3:09; Matt's fingers were heavily taped; after the bout, Snow hit both Dudleyz with Head

Test pinned WWF Hardcore Champion the Big Bossman in a non-title match at 4:04 after an interfering Albert accidentally dropped Bossman with a bicycle kick in the ring; Test wore a protective facemask for the bout but had it removed mid-way through as Albert assaulted him on the floor; after the bout, Bossman and Albert argued for the loss

Taka Michinoku & Sho Funaki defeated the Mean Street Posse in a handicap match at 3:02 when Funaki pinned Rodney with a roll up after Taka hit a missile dropkick; prior to the bout, Triple H told Stephanie McMahon the Posse's match was a reward and he hoped they could get their first tag team win

Rikishi (mystery opponent) defeated WWF World Champion Triple H (w/ Stephanie McMahon) via disqualification at 7:11 after the champion hit Rikishi with the title belt; Scotty 2 Hotty & Grandmaster Sexay escorted the challenger to the entrance stage before the contest; Stephanie provided guest commentary for the match; during the bout, X-Pac, WWF Tag Team Champions the Road Dogg & Billy Gunn were shown watching on backstage, enjoying seeing Triple H be beaten up; late in the match, Triple H hit Rikishi with a steel chair behind the referee's back but the challenger kicked out at 2; after the contest, Triple H repeatedly struck Rikishi with a steel chair, as referees ran out to the ring, but Rikishi repeatedly got back to his feet; after Triple H and Stephanie left ringside, Too Cool came out to celebrate with Rikishi
WWF Tag Team Champions Billy Gunn & the Road Dogg defeated Bradshaw in a No DQ handicap match when Gunn pinned Bradshaw after a chair shot from Road Dogg
Rikishi & Too Cool defeated Al Snow, Hardcore, & Crash Holly when Rikishi pinned Crash with the Bonzai Drop; after the bout, Snow hit both of his partners with Head and left
Test defeated Gangrel (w/ Luna) via disqualification when Luna pulled the referee out of the ring; after the bout, Test hit the pumphandle slam on Luna and the flying elbow drop on Gangrel
Matt & Jeff Hardy (w/ Terri Runnels) defeated Albert & WWF Hardcore Champion the Big Bossman
Edge & Christian defeated Kurt Angle & Steve Blackman when Edge pinned Blackman after Val Venis appeared on the OvalTron with Blackman's kendo stick
WWF Tag Team Champions Billy Gunn & the Road Dogg pinned Farooq in a No DQ handicap match; after the bout, Bradshaw made the save
The Godfather & D-Lo Brown defeated the Headbangers
Kane (w/ Tori) pinned WWF IC Champion Chris Jericho in a non-title match with the chokeslam and tombstone; after the bout, the Kat stole the IC title for Chyna

WWF World Champion Triple H & X-Pac (w/ Stephanie McMahon) defeated the Rock & the Big Show when Triple H pinned the Rock with the Pedigree; the Rock worked the entire match by himself and was hit with the chokeslam by Show after the bout
X-Pac pinned WWF Hardcore Champion Test in a non-title match with the X-Factor after the New Age Outlaws interfered; due to prematch stipulations, X-Pac earned the #30 slot in the Royal Rumble match
Al Snow & Steve Blackman defeated Kurt Angle & Davey Boy Smith when Blackman pinned the Bulldog with a kick to the face off the top

Matt Hardy (w/ Terri Runnels & Jeff Hardy) defeated D-Von Dudley (w/ Bubba Ray Dudley) via disqualification when Bubba interfered; after the bout, the Hardyz fought off the Dudleyz and put both men through tables
The Big Bossman fought Albert to a no contest

Rikishi & Too Cool defeated WWF IC Champions Chris Jericho & Chyna (w/ WWF Women's Champion the Kat) & Hardcore Holly via disqualification when Rikishi was triple-teamed; after the bout, Rikishi hit the Bonzai Drop on Chyna
Viscera pinned Crash Holly with a splash

Gangrel (w/ Luna) defeated Edge via count-out when Luna and the other participants in the Miss Rumble contest all attempted to seduce Edge, believing he was to be one of the judges for the competition

Kane defeated the Rock and the Big Show in a lumberjack battle royal; Show eliminated Rock with a chokeslam over the top to the floor; Kane eliminated Show with a backdrop after the Rock returned to the ring and hit the Rock Bottom on Show; the lumberjacks were the 27 other participants slated for the Royal Rumble

Al Snow defeated WWF Tag Team Champion Billy Gunn via disqualification after Gunn hit Snow with Steve Blackman's kendo stick; due to prematch stipulations, Snow and Blackman earned a tag team title shot against the New Age Outlaws
Edge & Christian defeated the Dudley Boyz when Edge pinned D-Von with the spear; after the bout, the Dudleyz put both of their opponents through tables, leaving Edge bleeding from the mouth
Viscera pinned Hardcore Holly with a Samoan Drop; after the bout, Crash and Hardcore attacked Viscera
Kane (w/ Tori) fought the Big Show to a no contest when DX interfered; after the bout, Kane was tied in the ringropes and witnessed Tori revealing that she was now with X-Pac

Too Cool fought the Godfather & D-Lo Brown to a no contest at around the 3-minute mark when the Godfather took the mic and said, if Too Cool wanted to party, they could party; the two teams then danced with Godfather's hos until Mark Henry and Mae Young appeaerd at the entrance stage, with Young announcing she was pregnant
WWF Hardcore Champion Test pinned Gangrel (w/ Luna) with the flying elbowdrop backstage
Tazz defeated Rodney & Pete Gas in a handicap match after applying the Tazzmission on Pete Gas; after the bout, Kurt Angle attacked Tazz and locked him in a chokehold
WWF IC Champion Chris Jericho (w/ Chyna) defeated Crash Holly (w/ Hardcore Holly) via submission with the Walls of Jericho

The Rock fought Rikishi to a no contest when the referee was knocked out and the Big Show and Triple H attacked both men; after the bout, Too Cool attempted to make the save but were beaten down as well
WWF IC Champion Chris Jericho (w/ Chyna) defeated Gangrel (w/ Luna) via submission with the Walls of Jericho at 2:51 after Chyna crotched an interfering Luna on the top rope
X-Pac (w/ Tori) pinned Dean Malenko at 4:08 with a low blow from behind and the X-Factor as Tori distracted the referee (Malenko's in-ring debut)

Jackie pinned WWF Women's Champion Harvey Whippleman to win the title at the 18-second mark with a bodyslam and elbow drop; after the bout, Jackie straipped Harvey down to his underwear; earlier in the show, Pat Patterson & Gerald Brisco had Ivory, the Fabulous Moolah, Mae Young, Luna, Jackie, BB, and Miss Kitty draw straws to see who would face the champion; Jackie drew the shortest straw and earned the right

Kurt Angle defeated the Rock and Tazz by pinning Tazz at 5:06 after both Angle and Tazz received Rock Bottoms and Rock was pulled out of the ring by an interfering Big Show; after the bout, Show chokeslammed Rock on the floor

WWF Tag Team Champions Billy Gunn & the Road Dogg defeated Eddie Guerrero & Perry Saturn at 4:29 when Road Dogg pinned Guerrero after Guerrero sustained a legit dislocated elbow while attempting the frog splash on Gunn; since DX won the series, the Radicalz were denied WWF contracts; after the commercial break, even though the Radicalz had already lost the series, Triple H volunteered to face Chris Benoit later in the night (Guerrero & Saturn's in-ring debut)

Al Snow & Steve Blackman defeated Crash & Hardcore Holly at 3:09 when Snow pinned Hardcore after Crash came off the top, with the momentum of the blow putting Snow on top for the win; after the bout, Hardcore attacked Crash on the floor and threw him into the steel ring steps

Rikishi (w/ Too Cool) defeated the Big Show via disqualification at 1:57 when Show hit Rikishi over the head with a steel chair, moments after Rikishi kicked out of the chokeslam; after the bout, Show fought off Too Cool as they attempted to make the save; moments later, Show was beaten down by the Rock who came out, hit Show with the chair, and followed with the Rock Bottom
WWF World Champion Triple H (w/ Stephanie McMahon) pinned Chris Benoit in a non-title match at 9:04 with a low blow and the Pedigree (Benoit's in-ring TV debut)
Kurt Angle pinned WWF European Champion Val Venis to win the title with the Angle Slam at 3:13 after crotching Venis on the top as he attempted the Money Shot
Perry Saturn defeated Grandmaster Sexay via submission with the Rings of Saturn; the referee failed to notice that Grandmaster's foot was on the ropes as the hold was applied

Edge & Christian defeated the Dudley Boyz when Christian pinned D-Von with a sunset flip and a missile dropkick from Edge; after the bout, Bubba Ray was wheeled up the ramp by EMTs until he and D-Von ran them off and brought BB into the ring where they powerbomb off the top through a table; moments later, BB was taken out of the ring on a stretcher
Dean Malenko defeated Scotty 2 Hotty via submission with the Texas Cloverleaf
